
===== FILE: Makefile =====
# ============================================================
# Makefile for the RISC-V compiler (Flex + Bison + C++)
#   make          build ./rvcc
#   make clean    remove generated files
# ============================================================

CXX       = g++
BISON     = bison
FLEX      = flex
SRC_DIR   = src
RT_DIR    = runtime
BUILD_DIR = build
TARGET    = rvcc
CXXFLAGS  = -std=c++14 -O2 -Wall -Wno-unused-function -I$(BUILD_DIR) -I$(SRC_DIR)

CORE_OBJS = $(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.o $(BUILD_DIR)/lex.yy.o \
            $(BUILD_DIR)/ast.o $(BUILD_DIR)/codegen.o $(BUILD_DIR)/backend.o

all: $(TARGET)

# ---- stage 0: compiler without runtime, used to translate the runtime library
$(BUILD_DIR)/rvcc0: $(CORE_OBJS) $(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_empty.o
	$(CXX) -o $@ $^

$(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_empty.cpp: | $(BUILD_DIR)
	echo 'extern const char *g_runtime_asm; const char *g_runtime_asm = "";' > $@

# ---- runtime library: C source -> assembly -> embedded string
$(BUILD_DIR)/runtime.s: $(RT_DIR)/runtime.c $(BUILD_DIR)/rvcc0
	$(BUILD_DIR)/rvcc0 --runtime $< $@

$(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_asm.cpp: $(BUILD_DIR)/runtime.s
	( echo 'extern const char *g_runtime_asm;'; \
	  echo 'const char *g_runtime_asm = R"RTASM('; \
	  cat $<; \
	  echo ')RTASM";' ) > $@

# ---- final compiler
$(TARGET): $(CORE_OBJS) $(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_asm.o
	$(CXX) -o $@ $^

$(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.cpp $(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.hpp: $(SRC_DIR)/parser.y | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(BISON) -d -o $(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.cpp $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/lex.yy.cpp: $(SRC_DIR)/lexer.l $(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.hpp | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(FLEX) -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.o: $(BUILD_DIR)/parser.tab.cpp $(SRC_DIR)/ast.h
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/lex.yy.o: $(BUILD_DIR)/lex.yy.cpp $(SRC_DIR)/ast.h
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/ast.o: $(SRC_DIR)/ast.cpp $(SRC_DIR)/ast.h
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/codegen.o: $(SRC_DIR)/codegen.cpp $(SRC_DIR)/ast.h
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/backend.o: $(SRC_DIR)/backend.cpp $(SRC_DIR)/backend.h
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_empty.o: $(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_empty.cpp
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_asm.o: $(BUILD_DIR)/runtime_asm.cpp
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(TARGET) output

.PHONY: all clean

===== FILE: run.sh =====
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# run.sh - test harness for the RISC-V compiler
#
# Usage:   ./run.sh [compiler] [test-directory] [output-directory]
# Default: ./run.sh ./rvcc test output
#
# Test files are classified by their file name:
#   t*.cpp / t*.c   valid programs: the compiler must succeed and write an
#                   assembly file (<name>.s) and an IR file (<name>.ir).
#                   If the RARS simulator is available the assembly is run
#                   and its output is compared with test/<name>.out
#                   (optional test/<name>.in is fed to stdin and
#                   test/<name>.args holds the command-line arguments).
#   e*.cpp / e*.c   programs with deliberate errors: the compiler must
#                   reject them and must NOT leave an assembly file.
#
# Simulator: RARS 1.6 (https://github.com/TheThirdOne/rars), run as
#   java -jar rars.jar rv64 nc me <file>.s
# Point RARS_JAR at the jar if it is not ./rars.jar or ~/rars.jar.
#
# Directives inside a source file (as comments):
#   // EXPECT-EXIT: N          expected compiler exit status
#   // EXPECT-IR: text         'text' must appear in the IR
#   // EXPECT-COUNT: text N    'text' must appear exactly N times in the IR
#   // EXPECT-NOT-IR: text     'text' must NOT appear in the IR
#   // EXPECT-ERR: text        'text' must appear in the diagnostics
#   // EXPECT-NO-ERR: text     'text' must NOT appear in the diagnostics
#   // EXPECT-NOIR              no output file may be produced
# ============================================================

EXE="${1:-./rvcc}"
TESTDIR="${2:-test}"
OUTDIR="${3:-output}"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"

if [ ! -x "$EXE" ]; then
    echo "Executable '$EXE' not found - run 'make' first."
    exit 2
fi
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

RARS=""
for c in "$RARS_JAR" ./rars.jar "$HOME/rars.jar"; do
    if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ]; then RARS="$c"; break; fi
done
if [ -n "$RARS" ] && ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then RARS=""; fi
if [ -z "$RARS" ]; then
    echo "Note: RARS simulator not found (set RARS_JAR); programs are compiled but not executed."
fi

pass=0
fail=0
total=0

count_in() { # count_in <file> <text>  -> number of exact occurrences
    grep -oF -- "$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '
}

check_ok=true
fails=""

run_test() {
    local src="$1" name base out outlog errlog
    name=$(basename "$src")
    base="${name%.*}"
    out="$OUTDIR/$base.ir"
    asm="$OUTDIR/$base.s"
    outlog="$WORK/$base.out"
    errlog="$WORK/$base.err"
    rm -f "$out" "$asm"
    total=$((total + 1))

    # ----- collect directives from the source -----
    local expect_exit="" expect_noir="" irs="" errs="" noirs="" noerrs="" counts=""
    local line
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        case "$line" in
            *EXPECT-EXIT:*)   expect_exit="${line##*EXPECT-EXIT: }";;
            *EXPECT-NOIR*)    expect_noir=1;;
            *EXPECT-IR:*)     irs="$irs
${line#*EXPECT-IR: }";;
            *EXPECT-COUNT:*)  counts="$counts
${line#*EXPECT-COUNT: }";;
            *EXPECT-NOT-IR:*) noirs="$noirs
${line#*EXPECT-NOT-IR: }";;
            *EXPECT-ERR:*)    errs="$errs
${line#*EXPECT-ERR: }";;
            *EXPECT-NO-ERR:*) noerrs="$noerrs
${line#*EXPECT-NO-ERR: }";;
        esac
    done < "$src"

    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "TEST: $name"
    "$EXE" -ir "$src" "$OUTDIR/$base.s" >"$outlog" 2>"$errlog"
    local rc=$?

    # ----- exit status -----
    if [ -n "$expect_exit" ]; then
        if [ "$rc" -ne "$expect_exit" ]; then
            note_fail "exit status $rc, expected $expect_exit"
        fi
    elif [[ "$name" == e* ]]; then
        if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then
            note_fail "exit status $rc, expected 1 (program must be rejected)"
        fi
    else
        if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            note_fail "exit status $rc, expected 0 (program must be accepted)"
        fi
    fi

    # ----- output files -----
    if [[ "$name" == e* && -z "$expect_exit" ]] || [ -n "$expect_noir" ]; then
        if [ -f "$asm" ]; then
            note_fail "assembly file '$asm' was produced but must not be"
        fi
    elif [ -z "$expect_noir" ]; then
        if [ ! -f "$asm" ] || [ ! -s "$asm" ]; then
            note_fail "no assembly file produced"
        fi
        if [ ! -f "$out" ] || [ ! -s "$out" ]; then
            note_fail "no IR file produced"
        fi
    fi

    # ----- execution on the simulator -----
    if [ -n "$RARS" ] && [[ "$name" == t* ]] && [ -s "$asm" ] && [ -f "$TESTDIR/$base.out" ]; then
        local args="" input=/dev/null
        [ -f "$TESTDIR/$base.args" ] && args=$(cat "$TESTDIR/$base.args")
        [ -f "$TESTDIR/$base.in" ] && input="$TESTDIR/$base.in"
        java -jar "$RARS" rv64 nc me "$asm" pa $args < "$input" > "$OUTDIR/$base.run" 2>/dev/null
        if ! diff -q "$TESTDIR/$base.out" "$OUTDIR/$base.run" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            note_fail "simulator output differs from $TESTDIR/$base.out (see $OUTDIR/$base.run)"
        fi
    fi

    # ----- IR content checks (only if the IR exists) -----
    if [ -f "$out" ] && { [ -n "$irs" ] || [ -n "$noirs" ] || [ -n "$counts" ]; }; then
        local t
        while IFS= read -r t; do
            [ -z "$t" ] && continue
            grep -qF -- "$t" "$out" || note_fail "IR does not contain: '$t'"
        done <<< "$irs"
        while IFS= read -r t; do
            [ -z "$t" ] && continue
            grep -qF -- "$t" "$out" && note_fail "IR unexpectedly contains: '$t'"
        done <<< "$noirs"
        while IFS= read -r t; do
            [ -z "$t" ] && continue
            local text n got
            text="${t% [0-9]*}"
            n="${t##* }"
            got=$(count_in "$out" "$text")
            if [ "$got" -ne "$n" ]; then
                note_fail "IR contains '$text' $got time(s), expected $n"
            fi
        done <<< "$counts"
    fi

    # ----- diagnostic checks -----
    local t
    while IFS= read -r t; do
        [ -z "$t" ] && continue
        grep -qF -- "$t" "$outlog" "$errlog" || note_fail "diagnostics do not contain: '$t'"
    done <<< "$errs"
    while IFS= read -r t; do
        [ -z "$t" ] && continue
        grep -qF -- "$t" "$outlog" "$errlog" && note_fail "diagnostics unexpectedly contain: '$t'"
    done <<< "$noerrs"

    if [ -n "$fails" ]; then
        echo ">> FAIL"
        printf '%s\n' "$fails" | sed 's/^/     /'
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    else
        echo ">> PASS"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    fi
}

note_fail() {
    fails="${fails}${1}
"
}

shopt -s nullglob
files=( "$TESTDIR"/*.cpp "$TESTDIR"/*.c )
sorted=()
while IFS= read -r f; do sorted+=("$f"); done < <(printf '%s\n' "${files[@]}" | sort)

for src in "${sorted[@]}"; do
    [ -e "$src" ] || continue
    fails=""
    run_test "$src"
done

rm -rf "$WORK"
echo "============================================================"
echo "Passed: $pass   Failed: $fail   Total: $total"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

===== FILE: README.md =====
# End-to-end compiler: C++ subset to RISC-V assembly

Written in C++ with Flex and Bison. The compiler reads a program in a C/C++
subset, checks it, and writes a RISC-V (RV64IMFD) assembly file.

## Required simulator
**RARS 1.6** (RISC-V Assembler and Runtime Simulator), 64-bit mode.
Download `rars1_6.jar` from https://github.com/TheThirdOne/rars/releases
(a copy is kept in this directory as `rars.jar`). Java 8 or newer is required.

```
java -jar rars.jar rv64 nc me output/prog.s              # run a program
java -jar rars.jar rv64 nc me output/prog.s pa 10 20     # with command-line arguments
```
Options: `rv64` selects 64-bit mode, `nc` hides copyright text, `me` sends
simulator messages to stderr, `pa` passes the remaining words to `main` as
`argv`. The program exit code is the value returned by `main`.

## Build and run
```
make                       # builds ./rvcc
./rvcc prog.cpp            # writes output/prog.s
./rvcc prog.cpp out.s      # writes out.s
./rvcc -ir prog.cpp out.s  # also writes out.ir (three-address code)
./rvcc -p prog.cpp         # also prints the three-address code
./run.sh ./rvcc            # runs every file in test/
make clean
```
Requirements: `g++`, `make`, `flex`, `bison`. `run.sh` also needs `java` to
execute the generated assembly; without it the programs are only compiled.

## Compiler stages
1. `src/lexer.l` - tokens and lexical errors.
2. `src/parser.y` - grammar, syntax errors, command-line driver.
3. `src/ast.cpp`, `src/ast.h` - types, class and struct layout, constant evaluation, error log.
4. `src/codegen.cpp` - semantic checks and three-address code (the IR).
5. `src/backend.cpp` - translation of the IR into RISC-V assembly.
6. `runtime/runtime.c` - C library (printf, scanf, files, strings, math, heap).
   It is compiled by this compiler during `make` and appended to every output.

Build order: the compiler is first linked without the runtime, translates
`runtime/runtime.c`, and is then linked again with the result embedded.

## Target model
- Sizes: `char` 1, `short` 2, `int` 4, `long` 8, `float` 4, `double` 8, pointer 8.
- Every variable and temporary lives in a stack slot; each IR instruction
  loads its operands into `t0`-`t2` / `ft0`-`ft1` and stores the result back.
- Frame: `s0` is the frame pointer, `ra` is saved at `-8(s0)`, the caller's
  `s0` at `-16(s0)`, locals below them.
- Calling convention: arguments are stored in consecutive 8-byte stack slots
  starting at `0(sp)` of the caller; the callee reads them at `0(s0)`, `8(s0)`, ...
  Results are returned in `a0` (integers, pointers) or `fa0` (float, double).
  Variadic functions walk the same slots.
- Program entry `_start` builds `argv` (with the program name first), calls
  `main` and exits with its return value.
- Heap: bump allocator over the simulator `sbrk` service.
- Output uses simulator system calls (print character, file write/read/open/close).

## Supported features
Basic: arithmetic, logical and bitwise operators, if-else, for, while,
do-while, switch, int and char arrays, pointers, structures, printf/scanf
(and cout/cin), function calls with arguments, goto/break/continue, static.

Advanced: recursion, dynamic memory (malloc/free/new/delete), command-line
input (`argc`/`argv`), typedef, references, enum, union, `until` loop,
multi-level pointers, multi-dimensional arrays, function overloading,
classes and objects, single inheritance (base destructors run after derived
ones), public/private/protected (enforced), constructors with initialiser
lists, destructors, out-of-class member definitions, variadic functions
(`va_list`, `va_start`, `va_arg`, `va_end`), function pointers (including
typedef'd and as members), lambdas (`[]`, `[=]`, `[&]`, `[x, &y]`, `-> type`),
`auto`, file handling (fopen, fclose, fgets, fputs, fprintf, fscanf, fread,
fwrite, fseek, ftell, rewind, feof, rename).

Library: printf family (`%d %i %u %x %X %o %c %s %p %f %e %g %%`, width,
precision, flags, `l` modifier), scanf family, string functions, ctype,
`atoi/atol/atof/strtol`, `abs`, `qsort`, `rand/srand`, `exit`, and math
(`sqrt sin cos tan atan exp log log10 pow fabs floor ceil round fmod`).

Not supported: `virtual` functions, operator overloading, templates,
namespaces, exceptions, range-based for, multiple inheritance, static class
members, function-like macros.

Simulator limits: standard error goes to standard output; `remove` cannot
delete a file; `fopen` modes `r`, `w`, `a` only; `free` does not recycle memory.

## Tests
`test/` holds 38 valid programs (`t01`-`t38`) covering every feature above and
29 programs with deliberate errors (`e01`-`e29`).

| File | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `t*.cpp` | must compile; assembly is run and compared with `t*.out` |
| `t*.in`, `t*.args` | optional standard input and command-line arguments |
| `t*.out` | expected output (reference output of a native build) |
| `e*.cpp` | must be rejected with diagnostics and no assembly file |

Directives written as comments inside a test (`EXPECT-IR`, `EXPECT-COUNT`,
`EXPECT-NOT-IR`, `EXPECT-ERR`, `EXPECT-EXIT`) check the generated IR and the
diagnostics. See the header of `run.sh`.

## Directory layout
```
src/       lexer.l  parser.y  ast.h  ast.cpp  codegen.cpp  backend.h  backend.cpp
runtime/   runtime.c
test/      t01..t38 (+ .out/.in/.args), e01..e29
Makefile   run.sh   rars.jar   README.md
```

===== FILE: src/ast.cpp =====
/* ============================================================
 * ast.cpp - Type system, declaration builders, struct layout,
 * constant-expression evaluation and error reporting.
 * ============================================================ */
#include "ast.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

map<string, Type *> g_typedefs;
map<string, Type *> g_tags;
map<string, long long> g_enum_consts;
map<string, string> g_macros;
vector<Node *> g_program;
vector<Type *> g_struct_list;

int g_lex_errors = 0, g_syn_errors = 0, g_sem_errors = 0;
static vector<string> g_report;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Error reporting
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
void report_error(const char *kind, int line, const string &msg)
{
    string s = string(kind) + " ERROR [Line " + std::to_string(line) + "]: " + msg;
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", s.c_str());
    g_report.push_back(s);
    if (!strcmp(kind, "LEXICAL"))       g_lex_errors++;
    else if (!strcmp(kind, "SYNTAX"))   g_syn_errors++;
    else                                g_sem_errors++;
}

void print_error_block(FILE *out)
{
    if (g_report.empty()) return;
    fprintf(out, "\n========================== ERROR REPORT =============================\n");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_report.size(); i++)
        fprintf(out, "%s\n", g_report[i].c_str());
    fprintf(out, "======================================================================\n");
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Types
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
Type *mkBase(TKind k, bool uns)
{
    static Type *cache[2][16] = {{nullptr}};
    Type *&slot = cache[uns ? 1 : 0][(int)k];
    if (!slot) {
        slot = new Type();
        slot->kind = k;
        slot->is_unsigned = uns;
        slot->complete = true;
    }
    return slot;
}

Type *tVoid()   { return mkBase(T_VOID); }
Type *tBool()   { return mkBase(T_BOOL); }
Type *tChar()   { return mkBase(T_CHAR); }
Type *tShort()  { return mkBase(T_SHORT); }
Type *tInt()    { return mkBase(T_INT); }
Type *tLong()   { return mkBase(T_LONG); }
Type *tFloat()  { return mkBase(T_FLOAT); }
Type *tDouble() { return mkBase(T_DOUBLE); }
Type *tStream() { return mkBase(T_STREAM); }

Type *mkPtr(Type *b)
{
    Type *t = new Type();
    t->kind = T_PTR;
    t->base = b;
    t->complete = true;
    return t;
}

Type *mkArray(Type *b, long long n)
{
    Type *t = new Type();
    t->kind = T_ARRAY;
    t->base = b;
    t->len = n;
    t->complete = true;
    return t;
}

Type *mkFunc(Type *ret, const vector<Type *> &params, bool variadic)
{
    Type *t = new Type();
    t->kind = T_FUNC;
    t->base = ret;
    t->ptys = params;
    t->fvariadic = variadic;
    t->complete = true;
    return t;
}

bool derivedFrom(Type *d, Type *b)
{
    for (Type *t = d; t; t = t->parent)
        if (t == b) return true;
    return false;
}

long long sizeOf(Type *t)
{
    if (!t) return 4;
    switch (t->kind) {
    case T_VOID: case T_BOOL: case T_CHAR: return 1;
    case T_SHORT:  return 2;
    case T_INT:    return 4;
    case T_LONG:   return 8;
    case T_FLOAT:  return 4;
    case T_DOUBLE: return 8;
    case T_PTR:    return 8;
    case T_STREAM: return 8;
    case T_ARRAY:  return t->len < 0 ? 0 : t->len * sizeOf(t->base);
    case T_STRUCT: return t->size;
    case T_FUNC:   return 1;
    }
    return 4;
}

long long alignOf(Type *t)
{
    if (!t) return 4;
    if (t->kind == T_ARRAY)  return alignOf(t->base);
    if (t->kind == T_STRUCT) return t->align < 1 ? 1 : t->align;
    long long s = sizeOf(t);
    return s < 1 ? 1 : s;
}

bool isInteger(Type *t)
{
    return t && (t->kind == T_BOOL || t->kind == T_CHAR || t->kind == T_SHORT ||
                 t->kind == T_INT || t->kind == T_LONG);
}
bool isFloat(Type *t)   { return t && (t->kind == T_FLOAT || t->kind == T_DOUBLE); }
bool isArith(Type *t)   { return isInteger(t) || isFloat(t); }
bool isPointer(Type *t) { return t && t->kind == T_PTR; }
bool isPtrLike(Type *t) { return t && (t->kind == T_PTR || t->kind == T_ARRAY); }

bool sameType(Type *a, Type *b)
{
    if (a == b) return true;
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    if (a->kind != b->kind) return false;
    switch (a->kind) {
    case T_PTR:    return sameType(a->base, b->base);
    case T_ARRAY:  return a->len == b->len && sameType(a->base, b->base);
    case T_STRUCT: return a->tag == b->tag && a->is_union == b->is_union;
    case T_FUNC:
        if (a->ptys.size() != b->ptys.size() || a->fvariadic != b->fvariadic) return false;
        if (!sameType(a->base, b->base)) return false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < a->ptys.size(); i++)
            if (!sameType(a->ptys[i], b->ptys[i])) return false;
        return true;
    default:       return a->is_unsigned == b->is_unsigned;
    }
}

string typeStr(Type *t)
{
    if (!t) return "int";
    string u = t->is_unsigned ? "unsigned " : "";
    switch (t->kind) {
    case T_VOID:   return "void";
    case T_BOOL:   return "bool";
    case T_CHAR:   return u + "char";
    case T_SHORT:  return u + "short";
    case T_INT:    return u + "int";
    case T_LONG:   return u + "long";
    case T_FLOAT:  return "float";
    case T_DOUBLE: return "double";
    case T_PTR:    return typeStr(t->base) + "*";
    case T_ARRAY:
        return typeStr(t->base) + "[" + (t->len >= 0 ? std::to_string(t->len) : "") + "]";
    case T_STRUCT: return string(t->is_union ? "union " : (t->is_class ? "class " : "struct ")) + t->tag;
    case T_STREAM: return "stream";
    case T_FUNC: {
        string r = typeStr(t->base) + "(";
        for (size_t i = 0; i < t->ptys.size(); i++) r += (i ? "," : "") + typeStr(t->ptys[i]);
        if (t->fvariadic) r += t->ptys.empty() ? "..." : ",...";
        return r + ")";
    }
    }
    return "int";
}

string declStr(Type *t, const string &name, bool ref)
{
    string dims;
    Type *b = t;
    while (b && b->kind == T_ARRAY) {
        dims += "[" + (b->len >= 0 ? std::to_string(b->len) : string("")) + "]";
        b = b->base;
    }
    return typeStr(b) + (ref ? "& " : " ") + name + dims;
}

const Field *findField(Type *st, const string &name)
{
    if (!st) return nullptr;
    for (size_t i = st->fields.size(); i-- > 0;)      /* last match wins: derived classes hide base members */
        if (st->fields[i].name == name) return &st->fields[i];
    return nullptr;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Nodes
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
Node *mkNode(NKind k, int line, const string &s)
{
    Node *n = new Node();
    n->kind = k;
    n->line = line;
    n->s = s;
    return n;
}

Node *mkK(NKind k, int line, const string &s, std::initializer_list<Node *> kids)
{
    Node *n = mkNode(k, line, s);
    for (Node *c : kids) n->kids.push_back(c);
    return n;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Declaration specifiers
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
Spec *mergeSpec(Spec *a, Spec *b)
{
    a->is_static   |= b->is_static;
    a->is_const    |= b->is_const;
    a->is_extern   |= b->is_extern;
    a->is_typedef  |= b->is_typedef;
    a->is_unsigned |= b->is_unsigned;
    a->is_signed   |= b->is_signed;
    a->is_short    |= b->is_short;
    a->is_auto     |= b->is_auto;
    a->longs       += b->longs;
    if (b->base != -1) a->base = b->base;
    if (b->named) a->named = b->named;
    delete b;
    return a;
}

Type *specToType(const Spec &s)
{
    if (s.named) return s.named;
    TKind k;
    switch (s.base) {
    case T_VOID:   k = T_VOID;   break;
    case T_BOOL:   k = T_BOOL;   break;
    case T_CHAR:   k = T_CHAR;   break;
    case T_FLOAT:  k = T_FLOAT;  break;
    case T_DOUBLE: k = T_DOUBLE; break;
    default:
        if (s.is_short)       k = T_SHORT;
        else if (s.longs > 0) k = T_LONG;
        else                  k = T_INT;
    }
    bool uns = s.is_unsigned && (k == T_CHAR || k == T_SHORT || k == T_INT || k == T_LONG);
    return mkBase(k, uns);
}

Type *applyDecl(Type *base, const Decl &d)
{
    Type *t = base;
    for (int i = 0; i < d.ptr; i++) t = mkPtr(t);
    if (d.fptr > 0) {                              /* int (*name)(params) */
        vector<Type *> pt;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < d.params.size(); i++) pt.push_back(d.params[i].ty);
        t = mkFunc(t, pt, d.variadic);
        for (int i = 0; i < d.fptr; i++) t = mkPtr(t);
    }
    for (int i = (int)d.dims.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) t = mkArray(t, d.dims[i]);
    return t;
}

Type *typeFromSpec(Spec *sp, int ptrCode)
{
    Type *t = specToType(*sp);
    int n = ptrCode % 1000;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) t = mkPtr(t);
    return t;
}

Type *lookupTypeName(const string &name, int line)
{
    map<string, Type *>::iterator it = g_typedefs.find(name);
    if (it != g_typedefs.end()) return it->second;
    it = g_tags.find(name);
    if (it != g_tags.end()) return it->second;
    report_error("SYNTAX", line, "unknown type name '" + name + "'");
    return tInt();
}

/* Builds the declaration nodes of one declaration statement from its type specifier and declarator list. */
Node *makeDeclaration(Spec *sp, vector<InitDecl> *list, int line)
{
    Node *group = mkNode(N_DECLLIST, line);
    if (!sp || !list) return group;
    Type *base = specToType(*sp);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < list->size(); i++) {
        Decl *d = (*list)[i].d;
        Type *ty = applyDecl(base, *d);
        if (sp->is_typedef) {
            if (!d->is_func) g_typedefs[d->name] = ty;
            continue;
        }
        if (d->is_func) {
            Node *f = mkNode(N_FUNC, d->line, d->name);
            f->ty = ty;
            f->params = d->params;
            f->variadic = d->variadic;
            f->is_static = sp->is_static;
            f->kids.push_back(nullptr);
            group->kids.push_back(f);
            continue;
        }
        Node *v = mkNode(N_DECL, d->line, d->name);
        v->ty = ty;
        v->is_static = sp->is_static;
        v->is_const = sp->is_const;
        v->is_ref = d->ref;
        v->is_auto = sp->is_auto;
        v->ctor_init = d->has_ctor;
        v->extra = d->cargs;
        v->flag = sp->is_extern;
        v->kids.push_back((*list)[i].init);
        group->kids.push_back(v);
    }
    return group;
}

Node *makeFunction(Spec *sp, Decl *d, Node *body, int line)
{
    Node *f = mkNode(N_FUNC, line, d->name);
    if (!d->is_func) {
        report_error("SYNTAX", line, "function body given for '" + d->name + "' which is not a function");
    }
    f->ty = applyDecl(specToType(*sp), *d);
    f->params = d->params;
    f->variadic = d->variadic;
    f->is_static = sp->is_static;
    f->is_ref = d->ref;
    f->kids.push_back(body);
    return f;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Struct / union definitions
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
static vector<Type *> s_stack;
static vector<int> s_access;               /* current access per open class */
static int s_anon = 0;

static Type *newStruct(const string &tag, bool isUnion)
{
    Type *t = new Type();
    t->kind = T_STRUCT;
    t->tag = tag;
    t->is_union = isUnion;
    t->complete = false;
    g_struct_list.push_back(t);
    return t;
}

Type *refTag(const char *tag, bool isUnion, int line)
{
    (void)line;
    map<string, Type *>::iterator it = g_tags.find(tag);
    if (it != g_tags.end()) return it->second;
    Type *t = newStruct(tag, isUnion);
    g_tags[tag] = t;
    return t;
}

void beginStruct(const char *tag, bool isUnion, int line)
{
    string name = tag ? tag : "";
    Type *t = nullptr;
    if (name.empty()) {
        name = "__anon" + std::to_string(++s_anon);
        t = newStruct(name, isUnion);
        g_tags[name] = t;
    } else {
        map<string, Type *>::iterator it = g_tags.find(name);
        if (it != g_tags.end() && it->second->kind == T_STRUCT && !it->second->complete) {
            t = it->second;
            t->is_union = isUnion;
        } else {
            if (it != g_tags.end())
                report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "redefinition of '" + name + "'");
            t = newStruct(name, isUnion);
            g_tags[name] = t;
        }
    }
    t->size = 0;
    t->align = 1;
    t->fields.clear();
    t->parent = nullptr;
    t->is_class = false;
    s_stack.push_back(t);
    s_access.push_back(0);
}

void setClassMode(bool isClass)
{
    if (s_stack.empty()) return;
    s_stack.back()->is_class = isClass;
    s_access.back() = isClass ? 2 : 0;
}

void setAccess(int a)
{
    if (!s_access.empty()) s_access.back() = a;
}

void setBase(Type *base, int line)
{
    if (s_stack.empty() || !base) return;
    Type *t = s_stack.back();
    if (base->kind != T_STRUCT || base->is_union) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "base class '" + typeStr(base) + "' is not a class or struct");
        return;
    }
    if (!base->complete) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "base class '" + typeStr(base) + "' has incomplete type");
        return;
    }
    t->parent = base;
    t->fields = base->fields;                  /* base subobject comes first */
    t->size = base->size;
    t->align = base->align;
}

static void fixVoid(ParamList *p)
{
    if (p->v.size() == 1 && p->v[0].ty && p->v[0].ty->kind == T_VOID && p->v[0].name.empty())
        p->v.clear();
}


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Member functions, constructors and destructors.  Each becomes an
 * ordinary function named "Class::name" with a hidden first
 * parameter 'this'.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
static Param thisParam(Type *cls)
{
    Param p;
    p.ty = mkPtr(cls);
    p.name = "this";
    return p;
}

static Node *buildMethod(Type *cls, int access, Type *base, const Decl &d, Node *body, int line)
{
    Node *f = mkNode(N_FUNC, line, cls->tag + "::" + d.name);
    f->ty = applyDecl(base, d);
    f->params.push_back(thisParam(cls));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < d.params.size(); i++) f->params.push_back(d.params[i]);
    f->variadic = d.variadic;
    f->cls = cls;
    f->access = access;
    f->is_ref = d.ref;
    f->kids.push_back(body);
    return f;
}

static Node *buildSpecial(Type *cls, int access, bool dtor, ParamList *pl, Node *body, int line)
{
    Node *f = mkNode(N_FUNC, line, cls->tag + "::" + (dtor ? "~" : "") + cls->tag);
    f->ty = tVoid();
    f->params.push_back(thisParam(cls));
    if (pl) for (size_t i = 0; i < pl->v.size(); i++) f->params.push_back(pl->v[i]);
    f->cls = cls;
    f->access = access;
    f->is_ctor = !dtor;
    f->is_dtor = dtor;
    f->kids.push_back(body);
    return f;
}

/* Prepends member / base initialisers to a constructor body. */
static void applyInits(Node *ctor, vector<Node *> *inits)
{
    if (!inits || !ctor->kids[0]) return;
    Node *body = ctor->kids[0];
    vector<Node *> pre;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < inits->size(); i++) {
        pre.push_back((*inits)[i]);
        if ((*inits)[i]->flag) ctor->has_binit = true;
    }
    body->kids.insert(body->kids.begin(), pre.begin(), pre.end());
}

/* Builds one entry of a constructor initialiser list (a member or the base class). */
Node *makeCtorInit(const char *name, vector<Node *> *args, bool isBase, int line)
{
    Node *self = mkNode(N_ID, line, "this");
    Node *st;
    if (isBase) {
        Node *call = mkNode(N_CALL, line, string(name) + "::" + name);
        call->kids.push_back(self);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < args->size(); i++) call->kids.push_back((*args)[i]);
        st = mkK(N_EXPRSTMT, line, "", {call});
        st->flag = true;                               /* marks a base initialiser */
    } else {
        Node *mem = mkK(N_MEMBER, line, name, {self});
        mem->flag = true;                              /* this->name */
        if (args->size() != 1) {
            const Field *f = s_stack.empty() ? nullptr : findField(s_stack.back(), name);
            if (f && f->ty->kind == T_STRUCT && !args->empty()) {
                /* multi-argument member init calls the member's constructor */
                Node *call = mkNode(N_CALL, line, f->ty->tag + "::" + f->ty->tag);
                call->kids.push_back(mkK(N_UN, line, "&", {mem}));
                for (size_t i = 0; i < args->size(); i++) call->kids.push_back((*args)[i]);
                st = mkK(N_EXPRSTMT, line, "", {call});
            } else {
                report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "initializer for member '" + string(name) +
                                               "' needs exactly one value");
                st = mkNode(N_EMPTY, line);
            }
        } else {
            st = mkK(N_EXPRSTMT, line, "", {mkK(N_ASSIGN, line, "=", {mem, (*args)[0]})});
        }
    }
    delete args;
    return st;
}

void addMethodDef(Spec *sp, Decl *d, Node *body, int line)
{
    if (s_stack.empty()) return;
    if (!d->is_func) {
        report_error("SYNTAX", line, "function body given for '" + d->name + "' which is not a function");
        return;
    }
    g_program.push_back(buildMethod(s_stack.back(), s_access.back(), specToType(*sp), *d, body, line));
}

void addCtor(const char *name, ParamList *pl, vector<Node *> *inits, Node *body, int line)
{
    if (s_stack.empty()) return;
    Type *cls = s_stack.back();
    if (cls->tag != name) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "constructor name '" + string(name) + "' does not match class '" + cls->tag + "'");
        return;
    }
    if (pl) fixVoid(pl);
    Node *f = buildSpecial(cls, s_access.back(), false, pl, body, line);
    applyInits(f, inits);
    g_program.push_back(f);
}

void addDtor(const char *name, Node *body, int line)
{
    if (s_stack.empty()) return;
    Type *cls = s_stack.back();
    if (cls->tag != name) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "destructor name '~" + string(name) + "' does not match class '" + cls->tag + "'");
        return;
    }
    g_program.push_back(buildSpecial(cls, s_access.back(), true, nullptr, body, line));
}

static Type *classByName(const char *name, int line)
{
    map<string, Type *>::iterator it = g_tags.find(name);
    if (it == g_tags.end() || it->second->kind != T_STRUCT || !it->second->complete) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "'" + string(name) + "' is not a defined class");
        return nullptr;
    }
    return it->second;
}

Node *makeOuterMethod(Spec *sp, int ptrCode, const char *cls, const char *name,
                      ParamList *pl, Node *body, int line)
{
    Type *c = classByName(cls, line);
    if (!c) return mkNode(N_EMPTY, line);
    Decl d;
    d.name = name;
    d.ptr = ptrCode % 1000;
    d.is_func = true;
    if (pl) { fixVoid(pl); d.params = pl->v; d.variadic = pl->variadic; }
    Node *f = buildMethod(c, 0, specToType(*sp), d, body, line);
    return f;
}

Node *makeOuterCtor(const char *cls, ParamList *pl, vector<Node *> *inits, Node *body, int line)
{
    Type *c = classByName(cls, line);
    if (!c) return mkNode(N_EMPTY, line);
    if (pl) fixVoid(pl);
    Node *f = buildSpecial(c, 0, false, pl, body, line);
    applyInits(f, inits);
    return f;
}

Node *makeOuterDtor(const char *cls, Node *body, int line)
{
    Type *c = classByName(cls, line);
    if (!c) return mkNode(N_EMPTY, line);
    return buildSpecial(c, 0, true, nullptr, body, line);
}

/* Adds the member declarations of a class or struct to its specifier and computes the layout. */
void addMembers(Spec *sp, vector<Decl *> *list, int line)
{
    if (s_stack.empty() || !sp || !list) return;
    Type *st = s_stack.back();
    Type *base = specToType(*sp);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < list->size(); i++) {
        Decl *d = (*list)[i];
        if (d->is_func) {                              /* in-class prototype */
            Node *m = buildMethod(st, s_access.back(), base, *d, nullptr, line);
            g_program.push_back(m);
            continue;
        }
        Type *ft = applyDecl(base, *d);
        if (ft->kind == T_VOID) {
            report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "member '" + d->name + "' declared void");
            continue;
        }
        if (ft->kind == T_STRUCT && !ft->complete) {
            report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "member '" + d->name + "' has incomplete type");
            continue;
        }
        for (size_t k = 0; k < st->fields.size(); k++) {
            if (st->fields[k].owner == st && st->fields[k].name == d->name) {
                report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "duplicate member '" + d->name + "'");
                break;
            }
        }
        long long a = alignOf(ft);
        long long off;
        if (st->is_union) {
            off = 0;
            st->size = std::max(st->size, sizeOf(ft));
        } else {
            off = (st->size + a - 1) / a * a;
            st->size = off + sizeOf(ft);
        }
        st->align = std::max(st->align, a);
        Field f;
        f.name = d->name;
        f.ty = ft;
        f.offset = off;
        f.owner = st;
        f.access = s_access.empty() ? 0 : s_access.back();
        st->fields.push_back(f);
    }
}

Type *endStruct()
{
    Type *t = s_stack.back();
    s_stack.pop_back();
    s_access.pop_back();
    long long a = t->align < 1 ? 1 : t->align;
    t->size = (t->size + a - 1) / a * a;
    t->complete = true;
    return t;
}

void init_builtin_types()
{
    g_typedefs["string"] = mkPtr(tChar());
    g_typedefs["size_t"] = mkBase(T_LONG, true);
    g_typedefs["va_list"] = mkPtr(tChar());
    Type *f = newStruct("FILE", false);
    f->complete = true;
    f->size = 8;
    g_typedefs["FILE"] = f;
    g_macros["EOF"] = "(-1)";
    g_macros["INT_MAX"] = "2147483647";
    g_macros["INT_MIN"] = "(-2147483647-1)";
    g_macros["RAND_MAX"] = "2147483647";
    g_macros["M_PI"] = "3.14159265358979";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Constant expression evaluation (array sizes, enumerators,
 * case labels, global initialisers)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
static CVal cvi(long long v) { CVal c; c.ok = true; c.i = v; return c; }
static CVal cvd(double v)    { CVal c; c.ok = true; c.isf = true; c.d = v; return c; }
static double asD(const CVal &c) { return c.isf ? c.d : (double)c.i; }

/* Evaluates a constant expression tree (array sizes, case labels, global initialisers). */
CVal constEval(Node *n)
{
    CVal bad;
    if (!n) return bad;
    switch (n->kind) {
    case N_INT: case N_CHAR: case N_BOOL: return cvi(n->iv);
    case N_NULL:  return cvi(0);
    case N_FLOAT: return cvd(n->dv);
    case N_ID: {
        map<string, long long>::iterator it = g_enum_consts.find(n->s);
        if (it != g_enum_consts.end()) return cvi(it->second);
        return bad;
    }
    case N_SIZEOF_T: return cvi(sizeOf(n->ty));
    case N_CAST: {
        CVal a = constEval(n->kids[0]);
        if (!a.ok) return bad;
        if (isFloat(n->ty)) return cvd(asD(a));
        if (isInteger(n->ty)) return cvi(a.isf ? (long long)a.d : a.i);
        return a;
    }
    case N_UN: {
        CVal a = constEval(n->kids[0]);
        if (!a.ok) return bad;
        if (n->s == "-") return a.isf ? cvd(-a.d) : cvi(-a.i);
        if (n->s == "+") return a;
        if (n->s == "!") return cvi(asD(a) == 0);
        if (n->s == "~" && !a.isf) return cvi(~a.i);
        return bad;
    }
    case N_COND: {
        CVal c = constEval(n->kids[0]);
        if (!c.ok) return bad;
        return constEval(asD(c) != 0 ? n->kids[1] : n->kids[2]);
    }
    case N_BIN: {
        CVal a = constEval(n->kids[0]);
        CVal b = constEval(n->kids[1]);
        if (!a.ok || !b.ok) return bad;
        const string &op = n->s;
        if (op == "&&") return cvi(asD(a) != 0 && asD(b) != 0);
        if (op == "||") return cvi(asD(a) != 0 || asD(b) != 0);
        if (a.isf || b.isf) {
            double x = asD(a), y = asD(b);
            if (op == "+") return cvd(x + y);
            if (op == "-") return cvd(x - y);
            if (op == "*") return cvd(x * y);
            if (op == "/") return y == 0 ? bad : cvd(x / y);
            if (op == "<") return cvi(x < y);
            if (op == ">") return cvi(x > y);
            if (op == "<=") return cvi(x <= y);
            if (op == ">=") return cvi(x >= y);
            if (op == "==") return cvi(x == y);
            if (op == "!=") return cvi(x != y);
            return bad;
        }
        long long x = a.i, y = b.i;
        if (op == "+") return cvi(x + y);
        if (op == "-") return cvi(x - y);
        if (op == "*") return cvi(x * y);
        if (op == "/") return y == 0 ? bad : cvi(x / y);
        if (op == "%") return y == 0 ? bad : cvi(x % y);
        if (op == "&") return cvi(x & y);
        if (op == "|") return cvi(x | y);
        if (op == "^") return cvi(x ^ y);
        if (op == "<<") return (y < 0 || y > 62) ? bad : cvi(x << y);
        if (op == ">>") return (y < 0 || y > 62) ? bad : cvi(x >> y);
        if (op == "<") return cvi(x < y);
        if (op == ">") return cvi(x > y);
        if (op == "<=") return cvi(x <= y);
        if (op == ">=") return cvi(x >= y);
        if (op == "==") return cvi(x == y);
        if (op == "!=") return cvi(x != y);
        return bad;
    }
    default:
        return bad;
    }
}

===== FILE: src/ast.h =====
/* ============================================================
 * ast.h - Types, abstract syntax tree and shared declarations
 * for the intermediate code generator.
 * ============================================================ */
#ifndef AST_H
#define AST_H

#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <initializer_list>

using std::string;
using std::vector;
using std::map;
using std::set;

/* ---------------- Types ---------------- */

enum TKind {
    T_VOID, T_BOOL, T_CHAR, T_SHORT, T_INT, T_LONG, T_FLOAT, T_DOUBLE,
    T_PTR, T_ARRAY, T_STRUCT, T_STREAM, T_FUNC
};

struct Type;

struct Field {
    string name;
    Type  *ty = nullptr;
    long long offset = 0;
    Type  *owner = nullptr;        /* class that declared the member     */
    int    access = 0;             /* 0 public, 1 protected, 2 private   */
};

struct Type {
    TKind kind;
    bool is_unsigned = false;
    Type *base = nullptr;          /* pointee or element type            */
    long long len = 0;             /* array length (-1 = unspecified)    */
    string tag;                    /* struct / union tag                 */
    bool is_union = false;
    bool complete = false;
    vector<Field> fields;
    long long size = 0;            /* struct / union size                */
    long long align = 1;
    Type *parent = nullptr;        /* base class (inheritance)           */
    bool is_class = false;
    vector<Type *> ptys;           /* T_FUNC: parameter types            */
    bool fvariadic = false;        /* T_FUNC: takes '...'                */
};

Type *mkBase(TKind k, bool uns = false);
Type *tVoid();
Type *tBool();
Type *tChar();
Type *tShort();
Type *tInt();
Type *tLong();
Type *tFloat();
Type *tDouble();
Type *tStream();
Type *mkPtr(Type *b);
Type *mkArray(Type *b, long long n);
Type *mkFunc(Type *ret, const vector<Type *> &params, bool variadic);
bool derivedFrom(Type *d, Type *b);

long long sizeOf(Type *t);
long long alignOf(Type *t);
bool isInteger(Type *t);
bool isFloat(Type *t);
bool isArith(Type *t);
bool isPointer(Type *t);
bool isPtrLike(Type *t);
bool sameType(Type *a, Type *b);
string typeStr(Type *t);
string declStr(Type *t, const string &name, bool ref = false);
const Field *findField(Type *st, const string &name);

/* ---------------- Declaration helpers ---------------- */

struct Spec {
    bool is_static = false, is_const = false, is_extern = false;
    bool is_typedef = false, is_unsigned = false, is_signed = false;
    bool is_short = false;
    bool is_auto = false;
    int  longs = 0;
    int  base = -1;                /* a TKind, or -1 if none given       */
    Type *named = nullptr;         /* typedef name / struct / enum type  */
};

struct Param {
    Type  *ty = nullptr;
    string name;
    bool   ref = false;
};

struct ParamList {
    vector<Param> v;
    bool variadic = false;
};

struct Node;

struct Decl {
    string name;
    int    ptr = 0;
    bool   ref = false;
    vector<long long> dims;
    int    fptr = 0;               /* >0: function-pointer declarator    */
    bool   has_ctor = false;       /* Foo f(args);                       */
    vector<Node *> cargs;
    bool   is_func = false;
    vector<Param> params;
    bool   variadic = false;
    int    line = 0;
};

/* ---------------- AST ---------------- */

enum NKind {
    /* expressions */
    N_INT, N_FLOAT, N_CHAR, N_STR, N_BOOL, N_NULL, N_ID,
    N_BIN, N_UN, N_ASSIGN, N_COND, N_COMMA, N_CALL, N_INDEX, N_MEMBER,
    N_CAST, N_SIZEOF_T, N_SIZEOF_E, N_NEW, N_COUT, N_CIN, N_ENDL,
    N_MCALL, N_ICALL, N_LAMBDA, N_VAARG,
    /* statements */
    N_BLOCK, N_EXPRSTMT, N_DECL, N_DECLLIST, N_IF, N_WHILE, N_DOWHILE,
    N_FOR, N_UNTIL, N_DOUNTIL, N_SWITCH, N_CASE, N_DEFAULT, N_BREAK,
    N_CONTINUE, N_RETURN, N_GOTO, N_LABEL, N_DELETE, N_EMPTY, N_INITLIST,
    N_FUNC
};

struct Node {
    NKind kind;
    int   line = 0;
    string s;                      /* operator, identifier, literal text */
    long long iv = 0;
    double dv = 0;
    Type *ty = nullptr;
    vector<Node *> kids;
    vector<Param> params;          /* N_FUNC only                        */
    bool variadic = false;
    bool is_static = false, is_const = false, is_ref = false, flag = false;
    /* classes, constructors, lambdas */
    Type *cls = nullptr;           /* owning class of a method           */
    vector<Node *> extra;          /* ctor args / new args / captures    */
    bool is_auto = false, ctor_init = false;
    bool is_ctor = false, is_dtor = false, has_binit = false;
    int  access = 0;
};

struct InitDecl {
    Decl *d;
    Node *init;
};

Node *mkNode(NKind k, int line, const string &s = "");
Node *mkK(NKind k, int line, const string &s, std::initializer_list<Node *> kids);

/* ---------------- Parser support ---------------- */

Spec *mergeSpec(Spec *a, Spec *b);
Type *specToType(const Spec &s);
Type *applyDecl(Type *base, const Decl &d);
Type *typeFromSpec(Spec *sp, int ptrCode);
Node *makeDeclaration(Spec *sp, vector<InitDecl> *list, int line);
Node *makeFunction(Spec *sp, Decl *d, Node *body, int line);
Type *lookupTypeName(const string &name, int line);

                      ParamList *pl, Node *body, int line);
Node *makeOuterCtor(const char *cls, ParamList *pl, vector<Node *> *inits, Node *body, int line);

===== FILE: src/backend.cpp =====
/* ============================================================
 * backend.cpp - RISC-V (RV64IMFD) code generator for the IR
 * Target simulator: RARS 1.6 (java -jar rars.jar rv64 prog.s)
 * ============================================================ */
#include "backend.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using std::map;
using std::set;
using std::string;
using std::vector;

namespace {

/* ---------------- Types ---------------- */

enum K { VOID, BOOL, CHAR, SHORT, INT, LONG, FLOAT, DOUBLE, PTR, ARRAY, STRUCT, FUNC };

struct Ty {
    K k = INT;
    bool uns = false;
    Ty *base = nullptr;
    long long len = 0;
    string tag;
    vector<Ty *> params;
    bool variadic = false;
};

struct Fld { string name; Ty *ty; long long off; };
struct SInfo { long long size = 0; bool isUnion = false; vector<Fld> fields; };

map<string, SInfo> g_structs;

Ty *mk(K k, Ty *base = nullptr)
{
    Ty *t = new Ty();
    t->k = k;
    t->base = base;
    return t;
}

Ty *T_INT()    { static Ty *t = mk(INT);    return t; }
Ty *T_LONG()   { static Ty *t = mk(LONG);   return t; }
Ty *T_CHAR()   { static Ty *t = mk(CHAR);   return t; }
Ty *T_DOUBLE() { static Ty *t = mk(DOUBLE); return t; }
Ty *T_VOID()   { static Ty *t = mk(VOID);   return t; }

bool isFlt(Ty *t) { return t && (t->k == FLOAT || t->k == DOUBLE); }
bool isPtrLike(Ty *t) { return t && (t->k == PTR || t->k == ARRAY || t->k == FUNC); }

string trim(const string &s)
{
    size_t a = 0, b = s.size();
    while (a < b && isspace((unsigned char)s[a])) a++;
    while (b > a && isspace((unsigned char)s[b - 1])) b--;
    return s.substr(a, b - a);
}

bool startsWith(const string &s, const string &p) { return s.compare(0, p.size(), p) == 0; }

long long sizeOf(Ty *t);

long long alignOf(Ty *t)
{
    if (!t) return 4;
    if (t->k == ARRAY) return alignOf(t->base);
    if (t->k == STRUCT) {
        long long a = 1;
        map<string, SInfo>::iterator it = g_structs.find(t->tag);
        if (it == g_structs.end()) return 8;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < it->second.fields.size(); i++) {
            long long fa = alignOf(it->second.fields[i].ty);
            if (fa > a) a = fa;
        }
        return a;
    }
    long long s = sizeOf(t);
    return s < 1 ? 1 : s;
}

long long sizeOf(Ty *t)
{
    if (!t) return 4;
    switch (t->k) {
    case VOID: case BOOL: case CHAR: return 1;
    case SHORT: return 2;
    case INT: case FLOAT: return 4;
    case LONG: case DOUBLE: case PTR: return 8;
    case ARRAY: return t->len < 0 ? 0 : t->len * sizeOf(t->base);
    case STRUCT: {
        map<string, SInfo>::iterator it = g_structs.find(t->tag);
        return it == g_structs.end() ? 8 : it->second.size;
    }
    case FUNC: return 1;
    }
    return 4;
}

/* Scans from the right to find the '(' that matches the final ')'. */
size_t matchOpen(const string &s)
{
    int depth = 0;
    for (size_t i = s.size(); i-- > 0;) {
        if (s[i] == ')') depth++;
        else if (s[i] == '(') { if (--depth == 0) return i; }
    }
    return string::npos;
}

vector<string> splitTopLevel(const string &s, char sep)
{
    vector<string> out;
    int depth = 0;
    bool inStr = false, inChr = false;
    string cur;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (inStr) { cur += c; if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.size()) cur += s[++i]; else if (c == '"') inStr = false; continue; }
        if (inChr) { cur += c; if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.size()) cur += s[++i]; else if (c == '\'') inChr = false; continue; }
        if (c == '"') { inStr = true; cur += c; continue; }
        if (c == '\'') { inChr = true; cur += c; continue; }
        if (c == '(' || c == '{' || c == '[') depth++;
        if (c == ')' || c == '}' || c == ']') depth--;
        if (c == sep && depth == 0) { out.push_back(trim(cur)); cur.clear(); continue; }
        cur += c;
    }
    if (!trim(cur).empty() || !out.empty()) out.push_back(trim(cur));
    return out;
}

/* Parses an IR type string (pointers, arrays, function types, struct tags) into a Ty. */
Ty *parseType(const string &str)
{
    string s = trim(str);
    if (s.empty()) return T_INT();
    if (s[s.size() - 1] == '*') return mk(PTR, parseType(s.substr(0, s.size() - 1)));
    if (s[s.size() - 1] == '&') return mk(PTR, parseType(s.substr(0, s.size() - 1)));
    if (s[s.size() - 1] == ')') {
        size_t o = matchOpen(s);
        if (o != string::npos) {
            Ty *f = mk(FUNC, parseType(s.substr(0, o)));
            string inner = s.substr(o + 1, s.size() - o - 2);
            vector<string> ps = splitTopLevel(inner, ',');
            for (size_t i = 0; i < ps.size(); i++) {
                if (ps[i] == "...") f->variadic = true;
                else if (!ps[i].empty()) f->params.push_back(parseType(ps[i]));
            }
            return f;
        }
    }
    if (s[s.size() - 1] == ']') {
        size_t o = s.rfind('[');
        string n = s.substr(o + 1, s.size() - o - 2);
        Ty *a = mk(ARRAY, parseType(s.substr(0, o)));
        a->len = n.empty() ? -1 : atoll(n.c_str());
        return a;
    }
    bool uns = false;
    if (startsWith(s, "unsigned ")) { uns = true; s = trim(s.substr(9)); }
    if (s == "unsigned") { uns = true; s = "int"; }
    Ty *t = nullptr;
    if (s == "void") t = mk(VOID);
    else if (s == "bool") t = mk(BOOL);
    else if (s == "char") t = mk(CHAR);
    else if (s == "short") t = mk(SHORT);
    else if (s == "int") t = mk(INT);
    else if (s == "long") t = mk(LONG);
    else if (s == "float") t = mk(FLOAT);
    else if (s == "double") t = mk(DOUBLE);
    else if (startsWith(s, "struct ") || startsWith(s, "class ") || startsWith(s, "union ")) {
        t = mk(STRUCT);
        t->tag = trim(s.substr(s.find(' ') + 1));
    } else t = mk(INT);
    t->uns = uns;
    return t;
}

/* Splits "type name[dims]" into a type and a name; sets isRef for "type& name". */
Ty *parseDecl(const string &decl, string &name, bool &isRef)
{
    string s = trim(decl);
    vector<long long> dims;
    while (!s.empty() && s[s.size() - 1] == ']') {
        size_t o = s.rfind('[');
        string n = s.substr(o + 1, s.size() - o - 2);
        dims.insert(dims.begin(), n.empty() ? -1 : atoll(n.c_str()));
        s = s.substr(0, o);
    }
    size_t sp = s.rfind(' ');
    string typ = sp == string::npos ? s : trim(s.substr(0, sp));
    name = sp == string::npos ? "" : trim(s.substr(sp + 1));
    isRef = false;
    if (!typ.empty() && typ[typ.size() - 1] == '&') { isRef = true; typ = trim(typ.substr(0, typ.size() - 1)); }
    Ty *t = parseType(typ);
    for (size_t i = dims.size(); i-- > 0;) {
        Ty *a = mk(ARRAY, t);
        a->len = dims[i];
        t = a;
    }
    return t;
}

Ty *innermost(Ty *t)
{
    while (t && t->k == ARRAY) t = t->base;
    return t;
}

/* ---------------- Literals ---------------- */

bool isIntLit(const string &s)
{
    if (s.empty()) return false;
    size_t i = (s[0] == '-' || s[0] == '+') ? 1 : 0;
    if (i >= s.size()) return false;
    if (s.size() > i + 2 && s[i] == '0' && (s[i + 1] == 'x' || s[i + 1] == 'X')) {
        for (size_t j = i + 2; j < s.size(); j++) if (!isxdigit((unsigned char)s[j])) return false;
        return true;
    }
    for (size_t j = i; j < s.size(); j++) if (!isdigit((unsigned char)s[j])) return false;
    return true;
}

bool isFloatLit(const string &s)
{
    if (s.empty()) return false;
    char c = s[0];
    if (!(isdigit((unsigned char)c) || c == '-' || c == '.' || c == '+')) return false;
    if (isIntLit(s)) return false;
    char *end = nullptr;
    strtod(s.c_str(), &end);
    return end && *end == 0 && end != s.c_str();
}

bool isIdent(const string &s)
{
    if (s.empty() || !(isalpha((unsigned char)s[0]) || s[0] == '_')) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++)
        if (!(isalnum((unsigned char)s[i]) || s[i] == '_' || s[i] == ':' || s[i] == '~')) return false;
    return true;
}

/* Decodes the escapes of a quoted literal body (without the quotes). */
string decodeEscapes(const string &b)
{
    string out;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        if (b[i] != '\\' || i + 1 >= b.size()) { out += b[i]; continue; }
        char c = b[++i];
        switch (c) {
        case 'n': out += '\n'; break;
        case 't': out += '\t'; break;
        case 'r': out += '\r'; break;
        case 'a': out += '\a'; break;
        case 'b': out += '\b'; break;
        case 'f': out += '\f'; break;
        case 'v': out += '\v'; break;
        case '\\': out += '\\'; break;
        case '\'': out += '\''; break;
        case '"': out += '"'; break;
        case 'x': {
            int v = 0;
            while (i + 1 < b.size() && isxdigit((unsigned char)b[i + 1])) {
                char h = b[++i];
                v = v * 16 + (isdigit((unsigned char)h) ? h - '0' : (tolower(h) - 'a' + 10));
            }
            out += (char)v;
            break;
        }
        default:
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '7') {
                int v = c - '0', n = 1;
                while (n < 3 && i + 1 < b.size() && b[i + 1] >= '0' && b[i + 1] <= '7') { v = v * 8 + (b[++i] - '0'); n++; }
                out += (char)v;
            } else out += c;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

/* ---------------- Function table ---------------- */

struct FuncInfo {
    string name;
    vector<string> pnames;
    vector<Ty *> ptypes;
    vector<bool> prefs;
    Ty *ret = nullptr;
    bool variadic = false;
};

string mangle(const string &n)
{
    string o;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n.size(); i++) {
        char c = n[i];
        if (c == ':') { if (i + 1 < n.size() && n[i + 1] == ':') i++; o += "__"; }
        else if (c == '~') o += "D_";
        else if (isalnum((unsigned char)c) || c == '_') o += c;
        else o += '_';
    }
    return o;
}

struct Var {
    Ty *ty = nullptr;
    long long off = 0;
    bool global = false;
    string label;
};

struct LibSig { char ret; bool variadic; };

map<string, LibSig> &libTable()
{
    static map<string, LibSig> m;
    if (!m.empty()) return m;
    const char *ints[] = {"printf", "scanf", "sprintf", "sscanf", "fprintf", "fscanf", "puts", "putchar", "getchar",
                          "fputs", "fputc", "fgetc", "fclose", "fseek", "feof", "fflush", "remove", "rename", "strcmp",
                          "strncmp", "atoi", "abs", "ungetc", "isxdigit", "ispunct", "rand", "toupper", "tolower",
                          "isdigit", "isalpha", "isspace", "isalnum", "isupper", "islower"};
    const char *longs[] = {"fread", "fwrite", "ftell", "strlen", "atol", "labs", "strtol", "clock", "time"};
    const char *dbls[] = {"atof", "sqrt", "sin", "cos", "tan", "fabs", "floor", "ceil", "log", "exp", "pow", "fmod",
                          "atan", "log10", "round"};
    const char *ptrs[] = {"gets", "fgets", "memset", "memcpy", "memmove", "realloc", "strcpy", "strncpy", "strcat",
                          "strchr", "strstr", "strdup", "strrchr", "strncat", "malloc", "calloc"};
    const char *voids[] = {"rewind", "qsort", "perror", "srand", "exit", "free"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(ints) / sizeof(ints[0]); i++) m[ints[i]] = LibSig{'i', false};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(longs) / sizeof(longs[0]); i++) m[longs[i]] = LibSig{'l', false};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(dbls) / sizeof(dbls[0]); i++) m[dbls[i]] = LibSig{'d', false};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(ptrs) / sizeof(ptrs[0]); i++) m[ptrs[i]] = LibSig{'p', false};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(voids) / sizeof(voids[0]); i++) m[voids[i]] = LibSig{'v', false};
    m["fopen"] = LibSig{'f', false};
    const char *va[] = {"printf", "scanf", "sprintf", "sscanf", "fprintf", "fscanf"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(va) / sizeof(va[0]); i++) m[va[i]].variadic = true;
    const char *stream[] = {"__print_int", "__print_long", "__print_char", "__print_str", "__print_bool", "__print_ptr",
                            "__print_double", "__print_endl", "__read_int", "__read_long", "__read_char", "__read_str",
                            "__read_double"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(stream) / sizeof(stream[0]); i++) m[stream[i]] = LibSig{'v', false};
    return m;
}

Ty *libRet(char c)
{
    switch (c) {
    case 'i': return T_INT();
    case 'l': return T_LONG();
    case 'd': return T_DOUBLE();
    case 'p': return mk(PTR, T_CHAR());
    case 'f': { Ty *f = mk(STRUCT); f->tag = "FILE"; return mk(PTR, f); }
    default:  return T_VOID();
    }
}

} /* namespace */

namespace {

/* ---------------- Code generator ---------------- */

class Backend {
public:
    bool runtime = false;
    std::ostringstream body, text, data;
    map<string, FuncInfo> funcs;
    map<string, Ty *> globals;
    map<string, string> strLabels;
    map<string, string> fconsts;
    vector<string> strOrder;
    int strCount = 0, fcCount = 0, skipCount = 0, copyCount = 0;

    FuncInfo *cur = nullptr;
    string fnLabel, fnMangled;
    map<string, Var> vars, temps;
    set<string> addrHolders;
    long long frameTop = 0;
    vector<string> pend;

    /* ---------- emit helpers ---------- */
    void I(const string &s) { body << "    " << s << "\n"; }
    void LBL(const string &l) { body << l << ":\n"; }
    static string num(long long v) { return std::to_string(v); }
    string strPrefix() const { return runtime ? "RS_" : "S_"; }
    string fconstPrefix() const { return runtime ? "RF_" : "F_"; }

    string funcLabel(const string &n) const
    {
        if (funcs.count(n)) return "fn_" + mangle(n);
        if (libTable().count(n) || startsWith(n, "__")) {
            if (n == "__ecall" || n == "__fsqrt") return "fn_" + mangle(n);
            return "fn___rt_" + mangle(n);
        }
        return "fn_" + mangle(n);
    }

    string strLabel(const string &decoded)
    {
        map<string, string>::iterator it = strLabels.find(decoded);
        if (it != strLabels.end()) return it->second;
        string l = strPrefix() + num(++strCount);
        strLabels[decoded] = l;
        strOrder.push_back(decoded);
        return l;
    }

    string fconst(const string &lit)
    {
        map<string, string>::iterator it = fconsts.find(lit);
        if (it != fconsts.end()) return it->second;
        string l = fconstPrefix() + num(++fcCount);
        fconsts[lit] = l;
        return l;
    }

    void loadImm(const string &reg, long long v)
    {
        I("li " + reg + ", " + num(v));
    }

    /* Adds a (possibly large) constant to a register. */
    void addImm(const string &dst, const string &src, long long v)
    {
        if (v >= -2000 && v <= 2000) { if (v != 0 || dst != src) I("addi " + dst + ", " + src + ", " + num(v)); return; }
        loadImm("t5", v);
        I("add " + dst + ", " + src + ", t5");
    }

    /* ---------- variables ---------- */
    Var *findVar(const string &n)
    {
        map<string, Var>::iterator it = vars.find(n);
        if (it != vars.end()) return &it->second;
        it = temps.find(n);
        if (it != temps.end()) return &it->second;
        map<string, Ty *>::iterator g = globals.find(n);
        if (g != globals.end()) {
            static Var gv;
            gv = Var();
            gv.ty = g->second;
            gv.global = true;
            gv.label = "G_" + mangle(n);
            return &gv;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    long long allocSlot(long long size)
    {
        if (size < 8) size = 8;
        frameTop = (frameTop + size + 7) / 8 * 8;
        return -(16 + frameTop);
    }

    static long long slotSize(Ty *t)
    {
        if (t && t->k == STRUCT) { long long s = (sizeOf(t) + 7) / 8 * 8; return s < 8 ? 8 : s; }
        return 8;
    }

    string memVar(const Var &v, const string &scratch)
    {
        if (v.global) { I("la " + scratch + ", " + v.label); return "0(" + scratch + ")"; }
        if (v.off >= -2000 && v.off <= 2000) return num(v.off) + "(s0)";
        loadImm(scratch, v.off);
        I("add " + scratch + ", s0, " + scratch);
        return "0(" + scratch + ")";
    }

    void addrVar(const Var &v, const string &reg)
    {
        if (v.global) { I("la " + reg + ", " + v.label); return; }
        addImm(reg, "s0", v.off);
    }

    /* ---------- loads, stores, conversions ---------- */
    void ldOp(Ty *t, const string &reg, const string &mem)
    {
        switch (t->k) {
        case BOOL: I("lbu " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case CHAR: I(string(t->uns ? "lbu " : "lb ") + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case SHORT: I(string(t->uns ? "lhu " : "lh ") + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case INT: I(string(t->uns ? "lwu " : "lw ") + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case FLOAT: I("flw " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case DOUBLE: I("fld " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        default: I("ld " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        }
    }

    void stOp(Ty *t, const string &reg, const string &mem)
    {
        switch (t->k) {
        case BOOL: case CHAR: I("sb " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case SHORT: I("sh " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case INT: I("sw " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case FLOAT: I("fsw " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        case DOUBLE: I("fsd " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        default: I("sd " + reg + ", " + mem); break;
        }
    }

    void narrow(Ty *to, const string &r)
    {
        switch (to->k) {
        case BOOL: I("snez " + r + ", " + r); break;
        case CHAR:
            if (to->uns) I("andi " + r + ", " + r + ", 255");
            else { I("slli " + r + ", " + r + ", 56"); I("srai " + r + ", " + r + ", 56"); }
            break;
        case SHORT:
            I("slli " + r + ", " + r + ", 48");
            I(string(to->uns ? "srli " : "srai ") + r + ", " + r + ", 48");
            break;
        case INT:
            if (to->uns) { I("slli " + r + ", " + r + ", 32"); I("srli " + r + ", " + r + ", 32"); }
            else I("addiw " + r + ", " + r + ", 0");
            break;
        default: break;
        }
    }

    /* Converts the value held in ir/fr from type 'from' to type 'to' in place. */
    void conv(Ty *from, Ty *to, const string &ir, const string &fr)
    {
        if (!from || !to || to->k == VOID || to->k == STRUCT || from->k == STRUCT) return;
        bool ff = isFlt(from), tf = isFlt(to);
        if (ff && tf) {
            if (from->k == DOUBLE && to->k == FLOAT) I("fcvt.s.d " + fr + ", " + fr);
            else if (from->k == FLOAT && to->k == DOUBLE) I("fcvt.d.s " + fr + ", " + fr);
            return;
        }
        if (!ff && tf) {
            string sfx = to->k == DOUBLE ? "d" : "s";
            bool wide = from->k == LONG || isPtrLike(from);
            string src = wide ? (from->uns ? "lu" : "l") : (from->uns && from->k == INT ? "wu" : "w");
            I("fcvt." + sfx + "." + src + " " + fr + ", " + ir);
            return;
        }
        if (ff && !tf) {
            string sfx = from->k == DOUBLE ? "d" : "s";
            if (to->k == BOOL) {
                I("fcvt." + sfx + ".w ft7, zero");
                I("feq." + sfx + " " + ir + ", " + fr + ", ft7");
                I("xori " + ir + ", " + ir + ", 1");
                return;
            }
            if (to->k == LONG || isPtrLike(to)) I("fcvt.l." + sfx + " " + ir + ", " + fr + ", rtz");
            else I("fcvt.w." + sfx + " " + ir + ", " + fr + ", rtz");
            narrow(to, ir);
            return;
        }
        if (to->k == BOOL || to->k == CHAR || to->k == SHORT || to->k == INT) narrow(to, ir);
    }

    /* ---------- operands ---------- */
    Ty *opType(const string &s)
    {
        if (isIntLit(s)) { long long v = strtoll(s.c_str(), nullptr, 0); return (v >= -2147483648LL && v <= 2147483647LL) ? T_INT() : T_LONG(); }
        if (isFloatLit(s)) return T_DOUBLE();
        if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '"') return mk(PTR, T_CHAR());
        if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '\'') return T_CHAR();
        Var *v = findVar(s);
        if (v) {
            if (v->ty->k == ARRAY) return mk(PTR, v->ty->base);
            return v->ty;
        }
        return T_INT();
    }

    /* Loads an operand into ir (integer/pointer) or fr (float); returns its type.
       Struct operands are represented by their address. */
    Ty *loadOp(const string &s, const string &ir, const string &fr)
    {
        if (isIntLit(s)) {
            long long v = strtoll(s.c_str(), nullptr, 0);
            loadImm(ir, v);
            return (v >= -2147483648LL && v <= 2147483647LL) ? T_INT() : T_LONG();
        }
        if (isFloatLit(s)) {
            string l = fconst(s);
            I("la t5, " + l);
            I("fld " + fr + ", 0(t5)");
            return T_DOUBLE();
        }
        if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '\'') {
            string d = decodeEscapes(s.substr(1, s.size() - 2));
            loadImm(ir, d.empty() ? 0 : (long long)(signed char)d[0]);
            return T_CHAR();
        }
        if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '"') {
            string d = decodeEscapes(s.substr(1, s.size() - 2));
            I("la " + ir + ", " + strLabel(d));
            return mk(PTR, T_CHAR());
        }
        if (s == "null" || s == "nullptr" || s == "NULL" || s == "false") { loadImm(ir, 0); return T_INT(); }
        if (s == "true") { loadImm(ir, 1); return T_INT(); }
        Var *v = findVar(s);
        if (v) {
            Ty *t = v->ty;
            bool holder = !v->global && addrHolders.count(s);
            if (t->k == ARRAY) { addrVar(*v, ir); return mk(PTR, t->base); }
            if (t->k == STRUCT && !holder) { addrVar(*v, ir); return t; }
            string m = memVar(*v, "t5");
            if (t->k == STRUCT) { I("ld " + ir + ", " + m); return t; }
            ldOp(t, isFlt(t) ? fr : ir, m);
            return t;
        }
        if (funcs.count(s) || libTable().count(s) || startsWith(s, "__")) {
            I("la " + ir + ", " + funcLabel(s));
            Ty *f = mk(FUNC, T_INT());
            if (funcs.count(s)) { f->base = funcs[s].ret; f->params = funcs[s].ptypes; }
            return mk(PTR, f);
        }
        loadImm(ir, 0);
        return T_INT();
    }

    /* ---------- lvalues ---------- */
    bool isLvalueText(const string &s)
    {
        if (s.empty() || isIntLit(s) || isFloatLit(s) || s[0] == '"' || s[0] == '\'') return false;
        if (s[0] == '*') return true;
        if (s.find("->") != string::npos) return true;
        if (s[s.size() - 1] == ']' && s.find('[') != string::npos) return true;
        size_t d = s.find('.');
        return d != string::npos && isIdent(s.substr(0, d));
    }

    Ty *elementOf(Ty *t)
    {
        Ty *e = t && (t->k == PTR || t->k == ARRAY) ? t->base : T_CHAR();
        e = innermost(e);
        if (!e || e->k == VOID || e->k == FUNC) return T_CHAR();
        return e;
    }

    const Fld *findField(Ty *st, const string &name)
    {
        map<string, SInfo>::iterator it = g_structs.find(st->tag);
        if (it == g_structs.end()) return nullptr;
        for (size_t i = it->second.fields.size(); i-- > 0;)
            if (it->second.fields[i].name == name) return &it->second.fields[i];
        return nullptr;
    }

    /* Computes the address of an lvalue expression into areg; returns the lvalue type. */
    Ty *lvAddr(const string &s, const string &areg)
    {
        if (s[0] == '*') {
            Ty *pt = loadOp(s.substr(1), areg, "ft3");
            Ty *e = (pt->k == PTR || pt->k == ARRAY) ? pt->base : T_INT();
            if (e && e->k == VOID) e = T_CHAR();
            return e;
        }
        size_t arrow = s.find("->");
        size_t dot = s.find('.');
        if (arrow != string::npos || (dot != string::npos && s[s.size() - 1] != ']')) {
            string base, path;
            Ty *st = nullptr;
            if (arrow != string::npos) {
                base = s.substr(0, arrow);
                path = s.substr(arrow + 2);
                Ty *pt = loadOp(base, areg, "ft3");
                st = pt->k == PTR ? pt->base : pt;
            } else {
                base = s.substr(0, dot);
                path = s.substr(dot + 1);
                Var *v = findVar(base);
                if (v && v->ty->k == STRUCT) {
                    st = v->ty;
                    if (!v->global && addrHolders.count(base)) { string m = memVar(*v, "t5"); I("ld " + areg + ", " + m); }
                    else addrVar(*v, areg);
                } else { Ty *pt = loadOp(base, areg, "ft3"); st = pt->k == PTR ? pt->base : pt; }
            }
            long long total = 0;
            Ty *cur = st;
            vector<string> parts;
            size_t p = 0;
            while (true) {
                size_t q = path.find('.', p);
                parts.push_back(path.substr(p, q == string::npos ? string::npos : q - p));
                if (q == string::npos) break;
                p = q + 1;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
                const Fld *f = cur ? findField(cur, parts[i]) : nullptr;
                if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "backend: unknown field '%s'\n", parts[i].c_str()); return T_INT(); }
                total += f->off;
                cur = f->ty;
            }
            if (total) addImm(areg, areg, total);
            return cur;
        }
        size_t br = s.find('[');
        string base = s.substr(0, br);
        string off = s.substr(br + 1, s.size() - br - 2);
        Var *v = findVar(base);
        Ty *elem;
        if (v && v->ty->k == ARRAY) { addrVar(*v, areg); elem = elementOf(v->ty); }
        else { Ty *pt = loadOp(base, areg, "ft3"); elem = elementOf(pt); }
        if (isIntLit(off)) {
            long long o = strtoll(off.c_str(), nullptr, 0);
            if (o) addImm(areg, areg, o);
        } else {
            loadOp(off, "t4", "ft3");
            I("add " + areg + ", " + areg + ", t4");
        }
        return elem;
    }

    /* Copies 'size' bytes from the address in src to the address in dst. */
    void copyMem(const string &src, const string &dst, long long size, long long align)
    {
        long long chunk = align >= 8 ? 8 : (align >= 4 ? 4 : (align >= 2 ? 2 : 1));
        string ld = chunk == 8 ? "ld" : chunk == 4 ? "lw" : chunk == 2 ? "lh" : "lb";
        string sd = chunk == 8 ? "sd" : chunk == 4 ? "sw" : chunk == 2 ? "sh" : "sb";
        if (size <= chunk * 8) {
            for (long long o = 0; o + chunk <= size; o += chunk) {
                I(ld + " t5, " + num(o) + "(" + src + ")");
                I(sd + " t5, " + num(o) + "(" + dst + ")");
            }
            return;
        }
        string l = string(runtime ? "RCP_" : "CP_") + num(++copyCount);
        loadImm("t6", size / chunk);
        LBL(l);
        I(ld + " t5, 0(" + src + ")");
        I(sd + " t5, 0(" + dst + ")");
        I("addi " + src + ", " + src + ", " + num(chunk));
        I("addi " + dst + ", " + dst + ", " + num(chunk));
        I("addi t6, t6, -1");
        I("bnez t6, " + l);
    }

    /* ---------- expressions ---------- */
    Ty *commonType(Ty *a, Ty *b)
    {
        if (a->k == DOUBLE || b->k == DOUBLE) return T_DOUBLE();
        if (a->k == FLOAT || b->k == FLOAT) return mk(FLOAT);
        if (isPtrLike(a) || isPtrLike(b)) { Ty *t = mk(LONG); t->uns = true; return t; }
        if (a->k == LONG || b->k == LONG) {
            Ty *t = mk(LONG);
            t->uns = (a->k == LONG && a->uns) || (b->k == LONG && b->uns);
            return t;
        }
        Ty *t = mk(INT);
        t->uns = (a->k == INT && a->uns) || (b->k == INT && b->uns);
        return t;
    }

    bool isCmp(const string &op)
    {
        return op == "==" || op == "!=" || op == "<" || op == "<=" || op == ">" || op == ">=";
    }

    /* Evaluates "a op b" leaving the result in t0 / ft0 and returning its type. */
    Ty *evalBinary(const string &a, const string &op, const string &b)
    {
        Ty *ta = loadOp(a, "t0", "ft0");
        Ty *tb = loadOp(b, "t1", "ft1");
        bool pa = isPtrLike(ta), pb = isPtrLike(tb);
        if ((op == "+" || op == "-") && (pa || pb)) {
            if (pa && pb) { I("sub t0, t0, t1"); return T_LONG(); }
            I(string(op == "+" ? "add" : "sub") + " t0, t0, t1");
            return pa ? ta : tb;
        }
        Ty *ct;
        if (op == "<<" || op == ">>") {
            ct = (ta->k == LONG) ? ta : mk(INT);
            if (ct->k == INT) ct->uns = ta->k == INT && ta->uns;
            conv(ta, ct, "t0", "ft0");
        } else {
            ct = commonType(ta, tb);
            conv(ta, ct, "t0", "ft0");
            conv(tb, ct, "t1", "ft1");
        }
        if (isFlt(ct)) {
            string s = ct->k == DOUBLE ? "d" : "s";
            if (op == "+") I("fadd." + s + " ft0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "-") I("fsub." + s + " ft0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "*") I("fmul." + s + " ft0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "/") I("fdiv." + s + " ft0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "==") I("feq." + s + " t0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "!=") { I("feq." + s + " t0, ft0, ft1"); I("xori t0, t0, 1"); }
            else if (op == "<") I("flt." + s + " t0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == "<=") I("fle." + s + " t0, ft0, ft1");
            else if (op == ">") I("flt." + s + " t0, ft1, ft0");
            else if (op == ">=") I("fle." + s + " t0, ft1, ft0");
            else { fprintf(stderr, "backend: operator '%s' not valid for floating point\n", op.c_str()); }
            return isCmp(op) ? T_INT() : ct;
        }
        bool wide = ct->k == LONG;
        bool u = ct->uns;
        string w = wide ? "" : "w";
        if (op == "+") I("add" + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "-") I("sub" + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "*") I("mul" + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "/") I(string(u ? "divu" : "div") + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "%") I(string(u ? "remu" : "rem") + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "&") I("and t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "|") I("or t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "^") I("xor t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "<<") I("sll" + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == ">>") I(string(u ? "srl" : "sra") + w + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == "==") { I("sub t0, t0, t1"); I("seqz t0, t0"); }
        else if (op == "!=") { I("sub t0, t0, t1"); I("snez t0, t0"); }
        else if (op == "<") I(string(u ? "sltu" : "slt") + " t0, t0, t1");
        else if (op == ">") I(string(u ? "sltu" : "slt") + " t0, t1, t0");
        else if (op == "<=") { I(string(u ? "sltu" : "slt") + " t0, t1, t0"); I("xori t0, t0, 1"); }
        else if (op == ">=") { I(string(u ? "sltu" : "slt") + " t0, t0, t1"); I("xori t0, t0, 1"); }
        else fprintf(stderr, "backend: unknown operator '%s'\n", op.c_str());
        return isCmp(op) ? T_INT() : ct;
    }

    vector<string> tokens(const string &s)
    {
        vector<string> out;
        string cur;
        bool inStr = false, inChr = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
            char c = s[i];
            if (inStr) { cur += c; if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.size()) cur += s[++i]; else if (c == '"') inStr = false; continue; }
            if (inChr) { cur += c; if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.size()) cur += s[++i]; else if (c == '\'') inChr = false; continue; }
            if (c == '"') { inStr = true; cur += c; continue; }
            if (c == '\'') { inChr = true; cur += c; continue; }
            if (c == ' ') { if (!cur.empty()) { out.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); } continue; }
            cur += c;
        }
        if (!cur.empty()) out.push_back(cur);
        return out;
    }

    /* Evaluates an IR right-hand side into t0 / ft0 and returns its type. */
    Ty *evalExpr(const string &rhs)
    {
        string r = trim(rhs);
        if (startsWith(r, "alloc ")) {
            loadOp(trim(r.substr(6)), "t0", "ft0");
            I("addi sp, sp, -16");
            I("sd t0, 0(sp)");
            I("jal ra, fn___rt_alloc");
            I("addi sp, sp, 16");
            I("mv t0, a0");
            return mk(PTR, T_VOID());
        }
        if (startsWith(r, "va_start ")) {
            string n = trim(r.substr(9));
            Var *v = findVar(n);
            long long off = v ? v->off + slotSize(v->ty) : 0;
            addImm("t0", "s0", off);
            return mk(PTR, T_CHAR());
        }
        if (startsWith(r, "va_arg ")) return evalVaArg(trim(r.substr(7)));
        if (r[0] == '(') {
            size_t close = r.find(')');
            int depth = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < r.size(); i++) {
                if (r[i] == '(') depth++;
                else if (r[i] == ')' && --depth == 0) { close = i; break; }
            }
            Ty *to = parseType(r.substr(1, close - 1));
            Ty *from = loadOp(trim(r.substr(close + 1)), "t0", "ft0");
            conv(from, to, "t0", "ft0");
            return to;
        }
        vector<string> tk = tokens(r);
        if (tk.size() == 3) return evalBinary(tk[0], tk[1], tk[2]);
        if (r[0] == '&' && r.size() > 1) return evalAddrOf(trim(r.substr(1)));
        if (r.size() > 1 && (r[0] == '-' || r[0] == '!' || r[0] == '~') && !isIntLit(r) && !isFloatLit(r)) {
            Ty *t = loadOp(trim(r.substr(1)), "t0", "ft0");
            if (r[0] == '-') {
                if (t->k == DOUBLE) I("fneg.d ft0, ft0");
                else if (t->k == FLOAT) I("fneg.s ft0, ft0");
                else I(string(t->k == LONG ? "sub" : "subw") + " t0, zero, t0");
                return t;
            }
            if (r[0] == '~') { I("xori t0, t0, -1"); return t; }
            if (isFlt(t)) { conv(t, mk(BOOL), "t0", "ft0"); I("xori t0, t0, 1"); }
            else I("seqz t0, t0");
            return T_INT();
        }
        if (isLvalueText(r)) {
            Ty *lt = lvAddr(r, "t3");
            if (lt->k == ARRAY) { I("mv t0, t3"); return mk(PTR, lt->base); }
            if (lt->k == STRUCT) { I("mv t0, t3"); return lt; }
            if (lt->k == FUNC) { I("mv t0, t3"); return mk(PTR, lt); }
            ldOp(lt, isFlt(lt) ? "ft0" : "t0", "0(t3)");
            return lt;
        }
        return loadOp(r, "t0", "ft0");
    }

    Ty *evalAddrOf(const string &x)
    {
        if (isLvalueText(x)) {
            Ty *lt = lvAddr(x, "t0");
            return mk(PTR, lt);
        }
        Var *v = findVar(x);
        if (v) {
            addrVar(*v, "t0");
