"cout"|"cerr"               { return COUT; }
"cin"                       { return CIN; }
"endl"                      { return ENDL; }

{LETTER}({LETTER}|{DIGIT})* {
    std::string name(yytext);
    note_tag(name);
    if (!class_stack.empty() && brace_depth == class_stack.back().depth &&
        name == class_stack.back().name && next_is_paren()) {
        yylval.sval = strdup(name.c_str());
        return CTORNAME;
    }
    std::map<std::string, std::string>::iterator m = g_macros.find(name);
    if (m != g_macros.end() && m->second.find(name) == std::string::npos) {
        const std::string body = m->second;
        for (int i = (int)body.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) unput(body[i]);
    } else if (is_typename(name.c_str())) {
        yylval.sval = strdup(name.c_str());
        return TYPENAME;
    } else {
        yylval.sval = strdup(name.c_str());
        return IDENTIFIER;
    }
}

0[xX]{HEX_DIGIT}+{INT_SUF}  { yylval.ival = (long long)strtoull(yytext, NULL, 16); return int_token(yytext); }
0[bB]{BIN_DIGIT}+{INT_SUF}  { yylval.ival = (long long)strtoull(yytext + 2, NULL, 2); return int_token(yytext); }
0{OCT_DIGIT}+{INT_SUF}      { yylval.ival = (long long)strtoull(yytext, NULL, 8); return int_token(yytext); }
0[0-9]*[89][0-9]*{INT_SUF}  {
    lex_error(std::string("Invalid octal literal '") + yytext + "' (digits 8 and 9 are not valid in base 8)");
    yylval.ival = 0; return INT_LIT;
}

{DIGIT}+"."{DIGIT}*{EXPO}{FLOAT_SUF}   { yylval.fval = strtod(yytext, NULL); return flt_token(yytext); }
{DIGIT}*"."{DIGIT}+{EXPO}{FLOAT_SUF}   { yylval.fval = strtod(yytext, NULL); return flt_token(yytext); }
{DIGIT}+{EXPO}{FLOAT_SUF}              { yylval.fval = strtod(yytext, NULL); return flt_token(yytext); }
{DIGIT}+"."{DIGIT}*{FLOAT_SUF}         { yylval.fval = strtod(yytext, NULL); return flt_token(yytext); }
{DIGIT}*"."{DIGIT}+{FLOAT_SUF}         { yylval.fval = strtod(yytext, NULL); return flt_token(yytext); }
{DIGIT}+{INT_SUF}                      { yylval.ival = (long long)strtoull(yytext, NULL, 10); return int_token(yytext); }

{DIGIT}+({LETTER}|{DIGIT}|".")*        {
    lex_error(std::string("Malformed numeric literal '") + yytext + "'");
    yylval.ival = 0; return INT_LIT;
}
"."{DIGIT}+({LETTER}|{DIGIT}|".")*     {
    lex_error(std::string("Malformed numeric literal '") + yytext + "'");
    yylval.fval = 0; return FLOAT_LIT;
}

\"([^"\\\n]|\\.)*\"         {
    validate_escapes(yytext);
    std::string body = decode_body(yytext + 1, (int)strlen(yytext) - 2);
    yylval.sstr = new std::string(body);
    return STRING_LIT;
}
\"([^"\\\n]|\\.)*\n         {
    line_num++;
    std::string t(yytext);
    t.erase(t.size() - 1);
    lex_error_at(line_num - 1, "Unterminated string literal " + t.substr(0, 60));
    yylval.sstr = new std::string();
    return STRING_LIT;
}
\"([^"\\\n]|\\.)*           {
    lex_error("Unterminated string literal " + std::string(yytext).substr(0, 60));
    yylval.sstr = new std::string();
    return STRING_LIT;
}

\'([^'\\\n]|\\.)*\'         {
    validate_escapes(yytext);
    int n = count_char_literal(yytext);
    std::string body = decode_body(yytext + 1, (int)strlen(yytext) - 2);
    if (n == 0) {
        lex_error("Empty character literal");
        yylval.ival = 0;
    } else {
        if (n > 1)
            lex_error(std::string("Multi-character literal ") + yytext + " (only 1 character allowed)");
        yylval.ival = body.empty() ? 0 : (long long)(signed char)body[0];
    }
    return CHAR_LIT;
}
\'([^'\\\n]|\\.)*\n         {
    line_num++;
    std::string t(yytext);
    t.erase(t.size() - 1);
    lex_error_at(line_num - 1, "Unterminated character literal " + t.substr(0, 60));
    yylval.ival = 0;
    return CHAR_LIT;
}
\'([^'\\\n]|\\.)*           {
    lex_error("Unterminated character literal " + std::string(yytext).substr(0, 60));
    yylval.ival = 0;
    return CHAR_LIT;
}

"<<="                       { return SHL_ASSIGN; }
">>="                       { return SHR_ASSIGN; }
"..."                       { return ELLIPSIS; }
"->"                        { return ARROW; }
"++"                        { return INC; }
"--"                        { return DEC; }
"<<"                        { return LSHIFT; }
">>"                        { return RSHIFT; }
"<="                        { return LE; }
">="                        { return GE; }
"=="                        { return EQ; }
"!="                        { return NE; }
"&&"                        { return ANDAND; }
"||"                        { return OROR; }
"+="                        { return ADD_ASSIGN; }
"-="                        { return SUB_ASSIGN; }
"*="                        { return MUL_ASSIGN; }
"/="                        { return DIV_ASSIGN; }
"%="                        { return MOD_ASSIGN; }
"&="                        { return AND_ASSIGN; }
"|="                        { return OR_ASSIGN; }
"^="                        { return XOR_ASSIGN; }

[-+*/%&|^~!<>=?:;,.(){}\[\]] { note_punct(yytext[0]); return yytext[0]; }

.                           {
    char buf[96];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Unrecognized character '%s' (ASCII %d)", yytext, (unsigned char)yytext[0]);
    lex_error(buf);
}

%%
static bool next_is_paren()
{
    int c;
    std::string skipped;
    while ((c = yyinput()) == ' ' || c == '\t') skipped += (char)c;
    bool r = (c == '(');
    if (c != EOF && c != 0) unput(c);
    for (int i = (int)skipped.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) unput(skipped[i]);
    return r;
}


===== FILE: src/parser.y =====
/* ============================================================
 * parser.y - Syntax analyzer and AST builder for the C++ subset.
 *
 * The grammar constructs an abstract syntax tree; code generation
 * is performed by codegen.cpp once the whole program has parsed.
 * ============================================================ */

%code requires {
#include "ast.h"
}

%{
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include "ast.h"

int  yylex(void);
void yyerror(const char *msg);
extern char *yytext;
extern FILE *yyin;
extern int   line_num;

int generate_ir(const string &infile, const string &outfile, bool printIR);
extern string g_ir_text;
bool generate_asm(const string &ir, const string &outfile, bool runtimeMode);

static long long g_enum_next = 0;

static long long evalDim(Node *e, int line)
{
    CVal c = constEval(e);
    if (!c.ok || c.isf || c.i < 0) {
        report_error("SEMANTIC", line, "array size must be a non-negative integer constant");
        return 1;
    }
    return c.i;
}

static void decodePtr(int code, Decl *d)
{
    d->ptr = code % 1000;
    d->ref = code >= 1000;
}

static Node *makeLambda(vector<Node *> *caps, ParamList *pl, Type *ret, int ptrCode, Node *body, int line)
{
    Node *n = mkNode(N_LAMBDA, line);
    if (caps) { n->extra = *caps; delete caps; }
    if (pl)   { n->params = pl->v; delete pl; }
    n->ty = ret;
    for (int i = 0; ret && i < ptrCode % 1000; i++) n->ty = mkPtr(n->ty);
    n->kids.push_back(body);
    return n;
}

static void fixVoidParam(ParamList *p)
{
    if (p->v.size() == 1 && p->v[0].ty && p->v[0].ty->kind == T_VOID && p->v[0].name.empty())
        p->v.clear();
}
%}

%define parse.error verbose
%expect 0
%locations

%union {
    long long  ival;
    double     fval;
    char      *sval;
    std::string *sstr;
    int        cnt;
    Node      *node;
    vector<Node *>        *nlist;
    vector<long long>     *dims;
    vector<Decl *>        *dlist;
    vector<InitDecl>      *idl;
    InitDecl              *idecl;
    ParamList             *plist;
    Param                 *param;
    Type      *type;
    Spec      *spec;
    Decl      *decl;
}

%token <sval> IDENTIFIER TYPENAME CLASSQ CTORNAME
%token <sstr> STRING_LIT
%destructor { delete $$; } <sstr>
%token <ival> INT_LIT LONG_LIT CHAR_LIT
%token <fval> FLOAT_LIT FLOATF_LIT

%token INT CHAR SHORT LONG FLOAT DOUBLE VOID BOOL SIGNED UNSIGNED
%token CONST STATIC EXTERN TYPEDEF STRUCT UNION ENUM INLINE
%token CLASS PUBLIC PRIVATE PROTECTED AUTO VA_ARG DELETE_ARR
%token IF ELSE WHILE DO FOR UNTIL SWITCH CASE DEFAULT BREAK CONTINUE RETURN GOTO
%token SIZEOF NEW DELETE TRUE FALSE NULLPTR USING NAMESPACE COUT CIN ENDL
%token INC DEC EQ NE LE GE ANDAND OROR LSHIFT RSHIFT ARROW ELLIPSIS
%token ADD_ASSIGN SUB_ASSIGN MUL_ASSIGN DIV_ASSIGN MOD_ASSIGN
%token AND_ASSIGN OR_ASSIGN XOR_ASSIGN SHL_ASSIGN SHR_ASSIGN

%precedence LOW_TAG
%precedence PTR_REDUCE
%right '=' ADD_ASSIGN SUB_ASSIGN MUL_ASSIGN DIV_ASSIGN MOD_ASSIGN AND_ASSIGN OR_ASSIGN XOR_ASSIGN SHL_ASSIGN SHR_ASSIGN
%right '?' ':'
%left  OROR
%left  ANDAND
%left  '|'
%left  '^'
%left  '&'
%left  EQ NE
%left  '<' '>' LE GE
%left  LSHIFT RSHIFT
%left  '+' '-'
%left  '*' '/' '%'
%right UNARY
%precedence LOW_NEW
%left  INC DEC '[' ']' '.' ARROW
%precedence LOWER_THAN_ELSE
%precedence ELSE

%type <node>  expr comma_expr opt_comma_expr stmt compound_stmt block_item
%type <node>  postfix_expr primary_expr
%type <node>  declaration for_init initializer function_definition
%type <nlist> block_items arg_list arg_list_opt init_items
%type <spec>  decl_specs decl_spec
%type <type>  type_name struct_spec enum_spec opt_base simple_type
%type <nlist> capture_list ctor_init_opt ctor_inits
%type <node>  capture ctor_init lambda
%type <cnt>   access_opt
%type <decl>  declarator
%type <idecl> init_declarator
%type <idl>   init_declarator_list
%type <plist> param_list param_list_opt
%type <param> param
%type <cnt>   ptr_opt ptr_list
%type <dims>  dims_opt
%type <dlist> member_decl_list
%type <sval>  tag_name
%type <sstr>  string_lit

%start program

%%

program
    : %empty
    | program external
    ;

external
    : function_definition               { g_program.push_back($1); }
    | declaration                       { for (size_t k = 0; k < $1->kids.size(); k++) g_program.push_back($1->kids[k]); }
    | USING NAMESPACE IDENTIFIER ';'    { free($3); }
    | ';'
    | error ';'                         { yyerrok; }
    | error '}'                         { yyerrok; }
    ;

function_definition
    : decl_specs declarator compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeFunction($1, $2, $3, @2.first_line); }
    | decl_specs ptr_opt CLASSQ IDENTIFIER '(' param_list_opt ')' compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeOuterMethod($1, $2, $3, $4, $6, $8, @4.first_line); free($3); free($4); }
    | decl_specs ptr_opt CLASSQ IDENTIFIER '(' param_list_opt ')' CONST compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeOuterMethod($1, $2, $3, $4, $6, $9, @4.first_line); free($3); free($4); }
    | CLASSQ TYPENAME '(' param_list_opt ')' ctor_init_opt compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeOuterCtor($1, $4, $6, $7, @1.first_line); free($1); free($2); }
    | CLASSQ '~' TYPENAME '(' ')' compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeOuterDtor($1, $6, @1.first_line); free($1); free($3); }
    ;

ctor_init_opt
    : %empty                    { $$ = nullptr; }
    | ':' ctor_inits            { $$ = $2; }
    ;

ctor_inits
    : ctor_init                 { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); $$->push_back($1); }
    | ctor_inits ',' ctor_init  { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($3); }
    ;

ctor_init
    : IDENTIFIER '(' arg_list_opt ')'
        { $$ = makeCtorInit($1, $3, false, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    | TYPENAME '(' arg_list_opt ')'
        { $$ = makeCtorInit($1, $3, true, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    ;

/* ---------------- Declarations ---------------- */

declaration
    : decl_specs init_declarator_list ';'   { $$ = makeDeclaration($1, $2, @1.first_line); }
    | decl_specs ';'                        { $$ = makeDeclaration($1, nullptr, @1.first_line); }
    ;

decl_specs
    : decl_spec                 { $$ = $1; }
    | decl_specs decl_spec      { $$ = mergeSpec($1, $2); }
    ;

decl_spec
    : STATIC     { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_static = true; }
    | EXTERN     { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_extern = true; }
    | TYPEDEF    { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_typedef = true; }
    | CONST      { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_const = true; }
    | INLINE     { $$ = new Spec(); }
    | INT        { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_INT; }
    | CHAR       { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_CHAR; }
    | FLOAT      { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_FLOAT; }
    | DOUBLE     { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_DOUBLE; }
    | VOID       { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_VOID; }
    | BOOL       { $$ = new Spec(); $$->base = T_BOOL; }
    | SHORT      { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_short = true; }
    | LONG       { $$ = new Spec(); $$->longs = 1; }
    | SIGNED     { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_signed = true; }
    | UNSIGNED   { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_unsigned = true; }
    | AUTO       { $$ = new Spec(); $$->is_auto = true; }
    | TYPENAME   { $$ = new Spec(); $$->named = lookupTypeName($1, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    | struct_spec { $$ = new Spec(); $$->named = $1; }
    | enum_spec   { $$ = new Spec(); $$->named = $1; }
    ;

tag_name
    : IDENTIFIER   { $$ = $1; }
    | TYPENAME     { $$ = $1; }
    ;

opt_base
    : %empty                        { $$ = nullptr; }
    | ':' access_opt TYPENAME       { $$ = lookupTypeName($3, @3.first_line); free($3); }
    ;

access_opt
    : %empty        { $$ = 0; }
    | PUBLIC        { $$ = 0; }
    | PROTECTED     { $$ = 1; }
    | PRIVATE       { $$ = 2; }
    ;

struct_spec
    : STRUCT tag_name %prec LOW_TAG
        { $$ = refTag($2, false, @1.first_line); free($2); }
    | UNION tag_name %prec LOW_TAG
        { $$ = refTag($2, true, @1.first_line); free($2); }
    | CLASS tag_name %prec LOW_TAG
        { $$ = refTag($2, false, @1.first_line); free($2); }
    | STRUCT tag_name opt_base '{' { beginStruct($2, false, @1.first_line); setBase($3, @1.first_line); free($2); } member_list '}'
        { $$ = endStruct(); }
    | CLASS tag_name opt_base '{' { beginStruct($2, false, @1.first_line); setClassMode(true); setBase($3, @1.first_line); free($2); } member_list '}'
        { $$ = endStruct(); }
    | UNION tag_name '{' { beginStruct($2, true, @1.first_line); free($2); } member_list '}'
        { $$ = endStruct(); }
    | STRUCT '{' { beginStruct("", false, @1.first_line); } member_list '}'
        { $$ = endStruct(); }
    | UNION '{' { beginStruct("", true, @1.first_line); } member_list '}'
        { $$ = endStruct(); }
    ;

member_list
    : %empty
    | member_list member
    ;

member
    : decl_specs member_decl_list ';'   { addMembers($1, $2, @1.first_line); }
    | decl_specs declarator compound_stmt
        { addMethodDef($1, $2, $3, @2.first_line); }
    | decl_specs declarator CONST compound_stmt
        { addMethodDef($1, $2, $4, @2.first_line); }
    | CTORNAME '(' param_list_opt ')' ctor_init_opt compound_stmt
        { addCtor($1, $3, $5, $6, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    | '~' CTORNAME '(' ')' compound_stmt
        { addDtor($2, $5, @2.first_line); free($2); }
    | CTORNAME '(' param_list_opt ')' ';'
        { addCtor($1, $3, nullptr, nullptr, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    | '~' CTORNAME '(' ')' ';'
        { addDtor($2, nullptr, @2.first_line); free($2); }
    | PUBLIC ':'                        { setAccess(0); }
    | PROTECTED ':'                     { setAccess(1); }
    | PRIVATE ':'                       { setAccess(2); }
    | ';'
    ;

member_decl_list
    : declarator                        { $$ = new vector<Decl *>(); $$->push_back($1); }
    | member_decl_list ',' declarator   { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($3); }
    ;

enum_spec
    : ENUM tag_name
        { $$ = tInt(); free($2); }
    | ENUM tag_name '{' { g_enum_next = 0; } enumerator_list opt_comma '}'
        { g_tags[$2] = tInt(); free($2); $$ = tInt(); }
    | ENUM '{' { g_enum_next = 0; } enumerator_list opt_comma '}'
        { $$ = tInt(); }
    ;

enumerator_list
    : enumerator
    | enumerator_list ',' enumerator
    ;

enumerator
    : IDENTIFIER
        { g_enum_consts[$1] = g_enum_next++; free($1); }
    | IDENTIFIER '=' expr
        {
            CVal c = constEval($3);
            if (!c.ok || c.isf) {
                report_error("SEMANTIC", @1.first_line, "enumerator value must be an integer constant");
                c.i = g_enum_next;
            }
            g_enum_consts[$1] = c.i;
            g_enum_next = c.i + 1;
            free($1);
        }
    ;

opt_comma
    : %empty
    | ','
    ;

ptr_list
    : '*'               { $$ = 1; }
    | '&'               { $$ = 1000; }
    | ptr_list '*'      { $$ = $1 + 1; }
    | ptr_list '&'      { $$ = $1 + 1000; }
    | ptr_list CONST    { $$ = $1; }
    ;

ptr_opt
    : %empty %prec PTR_REDUCE   { $$ = 0; }
    | ptr_list %prec PTR_REDUCE   { $$ = $1; }
    ;

dims_opt
    : %empty               { $$ = new vector<long long>(); }
    | dims_opt '[' ']'          { $$ = $1; $$->push_back(-1); }
    | dims_opt '[' expr ']'     { $$ = $1; $$->push_back(evalDim($3, @2.first_line)); }
    ;

declarator
    : ptr_opt IDENTIFIER dims_opt
        {
            Decl *d = new Decl();
            d->name = $2; free($2);
            decodePtr($1, d);
            d->dims = *$3; delete $3;
            d->line = @2.first_line;
            $$ = d;
        }
    | ptr_opt '(' ptr_list IDENTIFIER dims_opt ')' '(' param_list_opt ')'
        {
            Decl *d = new Decl();
            d->name = $4; free($4);
            decodePtr($1, d);
            d->fptr = $3 % 1000;
            if (d->fptr < 1) d->fptr = 1;
            d->dims = *$5; delete $5;
            d->params = $8->v;
            d->variadic = $8->variadic;
            delete $8;
            d->line = @4.first_line;
            $$ = d;
        }
    | ptr_opt IDENTIFIER '(' arg_list ')'
        {
            Decl *d = new Decl();
            d->name = $2; free($2);
            decodePtr($1, d);
            d->has_ctor = true;
            d->cargs = *$4; delete $4;
            d->line = @2.first_line;
            $$ = d;
        }
    | ptr_opt IDENTIFIER '(' param_list_opt ')'
        {
            Decl *d = new Decl();
            d->name = $2; free($2);
            decodePtr($1, d);
            d->is_func = true;
            d->params = $4->v;
            d->variadic = $4->variadic;
            delete $4;
            d->line = @2.first_line;
            $$ = d;
        }
    ;

param_list_opt
    : %empty               { $$ = new ParamList(); }
    | param_list                { $$ = $1; fixVoidParam($$); }
    | param_list ',' ELLIPSIS   { $$ = $1; $$->variadic = true; }
    ;

param_list
    : param                     { $$ = new ParamList(); $$->v.push_back(*$1); delete $1; }
    | param_list ',' param      { $$ = $1; $$->v.push_back(*$3); delete $3; }
    ;

param
    : decl_specs ptr_opt
        {
            Param *p = new Param();
            p->ty = typeFromSpec($1, $2);
            p->ref = $2 >= 1000;
            $$ = p;
        }
    | decl_specs ptr_opt IDENTIFIER dims_opt
        {
            Param *p = new Param();
            Type *t = typeFromSpec($1, $2);
            for (int i = (int)$4->size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) t = mkArray(t, (*$4)[i]);
            if (t->kind == T_ARRAY) t = mkPtr(t->base);
            p->ty = t;
            p->name = $3; free($3);
            p->ref = $2 >= 1000;
            delete $4;
            $$ = p;
        }
    | decl_specs ptr_opt '(' ptr_list IDENTIFIER ')' '(' param_list_opt ')'
        {
            Param *p = new Param();
            Type *t = typeFromSpec($1, $2);
            vector<Type *> pt;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < $8->v.size(); i++) pt.push_back($8->v[i].ty);
            t = mkFunc(t, pt, $8->variadic);
            int stars = $4 % 1000;
            for (int i = 0; i < (stars < 1 ? 1 : stars); i++) t = mkPtr(t);
            p->ty = t;
            p->name = $5; free($5);
            delete $8;
            $$ = p;
        }
    ;

type_name
    : decl_specs ptr_opt        { $$ = typeFromSpec($1, $2); }
    ;

init_declarator_list
    : init_declarator                           { $$ = new vector<InitDecl>(); $$->push_back(*$1); delete $1; }
    | init_declarator_list ',' init_declarator  { $$ = $1; $$->push_back(*$3); delete $3; }
    ;

init_declarator
    : declarator                    { $$ = new InitDecl(); $$->d = $1; $$->init = nullptr; }
    | declarator '=' initializer    { $$ = new InitDecl(); $$->d = $1; $$->init = $3; }
    ;

initializer
    : expr                          { $$ = $1; }
    | '{' '}'                       { $$ = mkNode(N_INITLIST, @1.first_line); }
    | '{' init_items opt_comma '}'  {
            Node *n = mkNode(N_INITLIST, @1.first_line);
            n->kids = *$2; delete $2;
            $$ = n;
        }
    ;

init_items
    : initializer                   { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); $$->push_back($1); }
    | init_items ',' initializer    { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($3); }
    ;

/* ---------------- Statements ---------------- */

compound_stmt
    : '{' block_items '}'
        {
            Node *n = mkNode(N_BLOCK, @1.first_line);
            n->kids = *$2; delete $2;
            $$ = n;
        }
    ;

block_items
    : %empty               { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); }
    | block_items block_item    { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($2); }
    ;

block_item
    : declaration               { $$ = $1; }
    | stmt                      { $$ = $1; }
    ;

stmt
    : compound_stmt                         { $$ = $1; }
    | comma_expr ';'                        { $$ = mkK(N_EXPRSTMT, @1.first_line, "", {$1}); }
    | ';'                                   { $$ = mkNode(N_EMPTY, @1.first_line); }
    | IF '(' comma_expr ')' stmt %prec LOWER_THAN_ELSE
        { $$ = mkK(N_IF, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $5, nullptr}); }
    | IF '(' comma_expr ')' stmt ELSE stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_IF, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $5, $7}); }
    | WHILE '(' comma_expr ')' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_WHILE, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $5}); }
    | DO stmt WHILE '(' comma_expr ')' ';'
        { $$ = mkK(N_DOWHILE, @1.first_line, "", {$2, $5}); }
    | DO stmt UNTIL '(' comma_expr ')' ';'
        { $$ = mkK(N_DOUNTIL, @1.first_line, "", {$2, $5}); }
    | UNTIL '(' comma_expr ')' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_UNTIL, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $5}); }
    | FOR '(' for_init opt_comma_expr ';' opt_comma_expr ')' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_FOR, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $4, $6, $8}); }
    | SWITCH '(' comma_expr ')' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_SWITCH, @1.first_line, "", {$3, $5}); }
    | CASE expr ':' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_CASE, @1.first_line, "", {$2, $4}); }
    | DEFAULT ':' stmt
        { $$ = mkK(N_DEFAULT, @1.first_line, "", {$3}); }
    | BREAK ';'                             { $$ = mkNode(N_BREAK, @1.first_line); }
    | CONTINUE ';'                          { $$ = mkNode(N_CONTINUE, @1.first_line); }
    | RETURN ';'                            { $$ = mkK(N_RETURN, @1.first_line, "", {nullptr}); }
    | RETURN comma_expr ';'                 { $$ = mkK(N_RETURN, @1.first_line, "", {$2}); }
    | GOTO IDENTIFIER ';'                   { $$ = mkNode(N_GOTO, @1.first_line, $2); free($2); }
    | IDENTIFIER ':' stmt                   { $$ = mkK(N_LABEL, @1.first_line, $1, {$3}); free($1); }
    | DELETE expr ';'                       { $$ = mkK(N_DELETE, @1.first_line, "", {$2}); }
    | DELETE_ARR expr ';'                   { $$ = mkK(N_DELETE, @1.first_line, "", {$2}); $$->flag = true; }
    | USING NAMESPACE IDENTIFIER ';'        { $$ = mkNode(N_EMPTY, @1.first_line); free($3); }
    | error ';'                             { yyerrok; $$ = mkNode(N_EMPTY, @1.first_line); }
    ;

for_init
    : declaration                           { $$ = $1; }
    | comma_expr ';'                        { $$ = mkK(N_EXPRSTMT, @1.first_line, "", {$1}); }
    | ';'                                   { $$ = nullptr; }
    ;

opt_comma_expr
    : %empty                           { $$ = nullptr; }
    | comma_expr                            { $$ = $1; }
    ;

comma_expr
    : expr                                  { $$ = $1; }
    | comma_expr ',' expr                   { $$ = mkK(N_COMMA, @2.first_line, "", {$1, $3}); }
    ;

/* ---------------- Expressions ---------------- */

lambda
    : '[' capture_list ']' '(' param_list_opt ')' compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeLambda($2, $5, nullptr, 0, $7, @1.first_line); }
    | '[' ']' '(' param_list_opt ')' compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeLambda(nullptr, $4, nullptr, 0, $6, @1.first_line); }
    | '[' capture_list ']' '(' param_list_opt ')' ARROW simple_type ptr_opt compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeLambda($2, $5, $8, $9, $10, @1.first_line); }
    | '[' ']' '(' param_list_opt ')' ARROW simple_type ptr_opt compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeLambda(nullptr, $4, $7, $8, $9, @1.first_line); }
    | '[' capture_list ']' compound_stmt
        { $$ = makeLambda($2, nullptr, nullptr, 0, $4, @1.first_line); }
    ;

simple_type
    : INT       { $$ = tInt(); }
    | CHAR      { $$ = tChar(); }
    | FLOAT     { $$ = tFloat(); }
    | DOUBLE    { $$ = tDouble(); }
    | VOID      { $$ = tVoid(); }
    | BOOL      { $$ = tBool(); }
    | LONG      { $$ = tLong(); }
    | SHORT     { $$ = tShort(); }
    | TYPENAME  { $$ = lookupTypeName($1, @1.first_line); free($1); }
    ;

capture_list
    : capture                   { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); $$->push_back($1); }
    | capture_list ',' capture  { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($3); }
    ;

capture
    : '='                       { $$ = mkNode(N_ID, @1.first_line, "="); }
    | '&'                       { $$ = mkNode(N_ID, @1.first_line, "&"); }
    | IDENTIFIER                { $$ = mkNode(N_ID, @1.first_line, $1); free($1); }
    | '&' IDENTIFIER            { $$ = mkNode(N_ID, @1.first_line, $2); $$->flag = true; free($2); }
    ;

string_lit
    : STRING_LIT                { $$ = $1; }
    | string_lit STRING_LIT     {
            *$1 += *$2;
            delete $2;
            $$ = $1;
        }
    ;

arg_list_opt
    : %empty               { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); }
    | arg_list                  { $$ = $1; }
    ;

arg_list
    : expr                      { $$ = new vector<Node *>(); $$->push_back($1); }
    | arg_list ',' expr         { $$ = $1; $$->push_back($3); }
    ;

expr
    : postfix_expr              { $$ = $1; }
    | INC expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "++", {$2}); }
    | DEC expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "--", {$2}); }
    | '-' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "-", {$2}); }
    | '+' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "+", {$2}); }
    | '!' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "!", {$2}); }
    | '~' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "~", {$2}); }
    | '*' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "*", {$2}); }
    | '&' expr %prec UNARY      { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @1.first_line, "&", {$2}); }
    | SIZEOF expr %prec UNARY   { $$ = mkK(N_SIZEOF_E, @1.first_line, "", {$2}); }
    | SIZEOF '(' type_name ')' %prec UNARY
        { $$ = mkNode(N_SIZEOF_T, @1.first_line); $$->ty = $3; }
    | '(' type_name ')' expr %prec UNARY
        { $$ = mkK(N_CAST, @1.first_line, "", {$4}); $$->ty = $2; }
    | NEW type_name %prec LOW_NEW
        { $$ = mkK(N_NEW, @1.first_line, "", {nullptr, nullptr}); $$->ty = $2; }
    | NEW type_name '[' expr ']'
        { $$ = mkK(N_NEW, @1.first_line, "", {$4, nullptr}); $$->ty = $2; $$->flag = true; }
    | NEW type_name '(' arg_list ')'
        { $$ = mkK(N_NEW, @1.first_line, "", {nullptr, (*$4)[0]}); $$->ty = $2; $$->extra = *$4; delete $4; }
    | expr '+' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "+", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '-' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "-", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '*' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "*", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '/' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "/", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '%' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "%", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '&' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "&", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '|' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "|", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '^' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "^", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr LSHIFT expr          { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "<<", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr RSHIFT expr          { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, ">>", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '<' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "<", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '>' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, ">", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr LE expr              { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "<=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr GE expr              { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, ">=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr EQ expr              { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "==", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr NE expr              { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "!=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr ANDAND expr          { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "&&", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr OROR expr            { $$ = mkK(N_BIN, @2.first_line, "||", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr '?' comma_expr ':' expr
        { $$ = mkK(N_COND, @2.first_line, "", {$1, $3, $5}); }
    | expr '=' expr             { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr ADD_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "+=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr SUB_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "-=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr MUL_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "*=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr DIV_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "/=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr MOD_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "%=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr AND_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "&=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr OR_ASSIGN expr       { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "|=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr XOR_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "^=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr SHL_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, "<<=", {$1, $3}); }
    | expr SHR_ASSIGN expr      { $$ = mkK(N_ASSIGN, @2.first_line, ">>=", {$1, $3}); }
    ;

postfix_expr
    : primary_expr
    | postfix_expr '[' comma_expr ']'   { $$ = mkK(N_INDEX, @2.first_line, "", {$1, $3}); }
    | postfix_expr '(' arg_list_opt ')'
        {
            if ($1->kind == N_ID) {
                Node *c = mkNode(N_CALL, @2.first_line, $1->s);
                c->kids = *$3; delete $3;
                $$ = c;
            } else {
                Node *c = mkK(N_ICALL, @2.first_line, "", {$1});
                for (size_t i = 0; i < $3->size(); i++) c->kids.push_back((*$3)[i]);
                delete $3;
                $$ = c;
            }
        }
    | postfix_expr '.' IDENTIFIER       { $$ = mkK(N_MEMBER, @2.first_line, $3, {$1}); free($3); }
    | postfix_expr ARROW IDENTIFIER     { $$ = mkK(N_MEMBER, @2.first_line, $3, {$1}); $$->flag = true; free($3); }
    | postfix_expr INC                  { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @2.first_line, "p++", {$1}); }
    | postfix_expr DEC                  { $$ = mkK(N_UN, @2.first_line, "p--", {$1}); }
    ;

primary_expr
    : INT_LIT                   { $$ = mkNode(N_INT, @1.first_line); $$->iv = $1; }
    | LONG_LIT                  { $$ = mkNode(N_INT, @1.first_line); $$->iv = $1; $$->s = "L"; }
    | FLOAT_LIT                 { $$ = mkNode(N_FLOAT, @1.first_line); $$->dv = $1; }
    | FLOATF_LIT                { $$ = mkNode(N_FLOAT, @1.first_line); $$->dv = $1; $$->s = "f"; }
    | CHAR_LIT                  { $$ = mkNode(N_CHAR, @1.first_line); $$->iv = $1; }
    | string_lit                { $$ = mkNode(N_STR, @1.first_line, *$1); delete $1; }
    | TRUE                      { $$ = mkNode(N_BOOL, @1.first_line); $$->iv = 1; }
    | FALSE                     { $$ = mkNode(N_BOOL, @1.first_line); $$->iv = 0; }
    | NULLPTR                   { $$ = mkNode(N_NULL, @1.first_line); }
    | IDENTIFIER                { $$ = mkNode(N_ID, @1.first_line, $1); free($1); }
    | COUT                      { $$ = mkNode(N_COUT, @1.first_line); }
    | CIN                       { $$ = mkNode(N_CIN, @1.first_line); }
    | ENDL                      { $$ = mkNode(N_ENDL, @1.first_line); }
    | '(' comma_expr ')'        { $$ = $2; }
    | VA_ARG '(' expr ',' type_name ')'
        { $$ = mkK(N_VAARG, @1.first_line, "", {$3}); $$->ty = $5; }
    | lambda                    { $$ = $1; }
    ;

%%

void yyerror(const char *msg)
{
    std::string m(msg);
    const std::string pre = "syntax error, ";
    if (m.compare(0, pre.size(), pre) == 0)
        m = m.substr(pre.size());
    else if (m == "syntax error")
        m = "unexpected token";
    report_error("SYNTAX", yylloc.first_line, m + " (near '" + std::string(yytext ? yytext : "") + "')");
}

static bool is_directory(const char *path)
{
    struct stat st;
    return stat(path, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
}

static string default_output(const string &in)
{
    string base = in;
    size_t slash = base.find_last_of("/\\");
    if (slash != string::npos) base = base.substr(slash + 1);
    size_t dot = base.find_last_of('.');
    if (dot != string::npos) base = base.substr(0, dot);
    mkdir("output", 0755);
    return "output/" + base + ".s";
}

/* Command-line driver: parse, generate IR, translate to assembly and write the output file. */
int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    string input, output;
    bool printIR = false, keepIR = false, runtimeMode = false;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        string a = argv[i];
        if (a == "-p" || a == "--print") printIR = true;
        else if (a == "-ir" || a == "--ir") keepIR = true;
        else if (a == "--runtime") runtimeMode = true;
        else if (input.empty()) input = a;
        else if (output.empty()) output = a;
    }
    if (input.empty()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s [-ir] [-p] <source-file> [output.s]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    if (is_directory(input.c_str())) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: '%s' is a directory, not a source file\n", input.c_str());
        return 2;
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(input.c_str(), "r");
    if (!f) {
        perror(input.c_str());
        return 2;
    }
    if (output.empty()) output = default_output(input);

    yyin = f;
    init_builtin_types();
    int rc = yyparse();
    fclose(f);

    if (rc != 0 || g_lex_errors > 0 || g_syn_errors > 0) {
        print_error_block(stdout);
        printf("\n>> %d lexical error(s), %d syntax error(s). No code generated.\n",
               g_lex_errors, g_syn_errors);
        remove(output.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    string irPath;
    if (keepIR) {
        irPath = output;
        size_t dot = irPath.find_last_of('.');
        irPath = (dot == string::npos ? irPath : irPath.substr(0, dot)) + ".ir";
    }
    int sem = generate_ir(input, irPath, printIR);
    if (sem > 0) {
        print_error_block(stdout);
        printf("\n>> 0 lexical error(s), 0 syntax error(s), %d semantic error(s). No code generated.\n", sem);
        remove(output.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    if (!generate_asm(g_ir_text, output, runtimeMode)) return 1;
    printf(">> Assembly written to %s\n", output.c_str());
    return 0;
}

===== FILE: runtime/runtime.c =====
/* ============================================================
 * runtime.c - C library for the RISC-V target
 * Compiled by this compiler itself and appended to every
 * generated assembly file.  System services use RARS ecalls
 * through the __ecall(number, a0, a1, a2) intrinsic.
 * ============================================================ */

long __ecall(long n, long a, long b, long c);
double __fsqrt(double x);

/* ---------------- memory ---------------- */

void *__rt_alloc(long n)
{
    long total = (n + 23) / 8 * 8;
    long p = __ecall(9, total, 0, 0);
    *(long *)p = n;
    return (void *)(p + 16);
}

void __rt_free(void *p)
{
}

void *__rt_memset(void *d, int c, long n)
{
    char *p = (char *)d;
    long i = 0;
    while (i < n) { p[i] = (char)c; i++; }
    return d;
}

void *__rt_memcpy(void *d, void *s, long n)
{
    char *a = (char *)d;
    char *b = (char *)s;
    long i = 0;
    while (i < n) { a[i] = b[i]; i++; }
    return d;
}

void *__rt_memmove(void *d, void *s, long n)
{
    char *a = (char *)d;
    char *b = (char *)s;
    long i;
    if (a < b) {
        i = 0;
        while (i < n) { a[i] = b[i]; i++; }
    } else {
        i = n;
        while (i > 0) { i--; a[i] = b[i]; }
    }
    return d;
}

void *__rt_realloc(void *p, long n)
{
    if (p == 0) return __rt_alloc(n);
    long old = *(long *)((char *)p - 16);
    void *q = __rt_alloc(n);
    __rt_memcpy(q, p, old < n ? old : n);
    return q;
}

/* ---------------- characters ---------------- */

int __rt_isdigit(int c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
int __rt_isupper(int c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'; }
int __rt_islower(int c) { return c >= 'a' && c <= 'z'; }
int __rt_isalpha(int c) { return __rt_isupper(c) || __rt_islower(c); }
int __rt_isalnum(int c) { return __rt_isalpha(c) || __rt_isdigit(c); }
int __rt_isspace(int c) { return c == ' ' || (c >= 9 && c <= 13); }
int __rt_isxdigit(int c) { return __rt_isdigit(c) || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F'); }
int __rt_ispunct(int c) { return c > 32 && c < 127 && !__rt_isalnum(c); }
int __rt_toupper(int c) { return __rt_islower(c) ? c - 32 : c; }
int __rt_tolower(int c) { return __rt_isupper(c) ? c + 32 : c; }

/* ---------------- strings ---------------- */

long __rt_strlen(char *s)
{
    long n = 0;
    while (s[n]) n++;
    return n;
}

char *__rt_strcpy(char *d, char *s)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (s[i]) { d[i] = s[i]; i++; }
    d[i] = 0;
    return d;
}

char *__rt_strncpy(char *d, char *s, long n)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (i < n && s[i]) { d[i] = s[i]; i++; }
    while (i < n) { d[i] = 0; i++; }
    return d;
}

char *__rt_strcat(char *d, char *s)
{
    long n = __rt_strlen(d);
    __rt_strcpy(d + n, s);
    return d;
}

char *__rt_strncat(char *d, char *s, long n)
{
    long k = __rt_strlen(d);
    long i = 0;
    while (i < n && s[i]) { d[k + i] = s[i]; i++; }
    d[k + i] = 0;
    return d;
}

int __rt_strcmp(char *a, char *b)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (a[i] && a[i] == b[i]) i++;
    return (int)((unsigned char)a[i]) - (int)((unsigned char)b[i]);
}

int __rt_strncmp(char *a, char *b, long n)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (i < n && a[i] && a[i] == b[i]) i++;
    if (i == n) return 0;
    return (int)((unsigned char)a[i]) - (int)((unsigned char)b[i]);
}

char *__rt_strchr(char *s, int c)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (1) {
        if (s[i] == (char)c) return s + i;
        if (s[i] == 0) return 0;
        i++;
    }
    return 0;
}

char *__rt_strrchr(char *s, int c)
{
    char *r = 0;
    long i = 0;
    while (1) {
        if (s[i] == (char)c) r = s + i;
        if (s[i] == 0) break;
        i++;
    }
    return r;
}

char *__rt_strstr(char *h, char *n)
{
    long hl = __rt_strlen(h);
    long nl = __rt_strlen(n);
    long i = 0;
    while (i + nl <= hl) {
        if (__rt_strncmp(h + i, n, nl) == 0) return h + i;
        i++;
    }
    return 0;
}

char *__rt_strdup(char *s)
{
    long n = __rt_strlen(s);
    char *d = (char *)__rt_alloc(n + 1);
    __rt_strcpy(d, s);
    return d;
}

long __rt_strtol(char *s, char **end, int base)
{
    long i = 0;
    long sign = 1;
    long v = 0;
    while (__rt_isspace(s[i])) i++;
    if (s[i] == '-') { sign = -1; i++; }
    else if (s[i] == '+') i++;
    if ((base == 0 || base == 16) && s[i] == '0' && (s[i + 1] == 'x' || s[i + 1] == 'X')) { base = 16; i = i + 2; }
    else if (base == 0 && s[i] == '0') base = 8;
    else if (base == 0) base = 10;
    while (1) {
        int c = s[i];
        int d;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') d = c - '0';
        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') d = c - 'a' + 10;
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') d = c - 'A' + 10;
        else break;
        if (d >= base) break;
        v = v * base + d;
        i++;
    }
    if (end) *end = s + i;
    return sign * v;
}

long __rt_atol(char *s) { return __rt_strtol(s, 0, 10); }
int __rt_atoi(char *s) { return (int)__rt_strtol(s, 0, 10); }

double __rt_atof(char *s)
{
    long i = 0;
    double sign = 1.0;
    double v = 0.0;
    while (__rt_isspace(s[i])) i++;
    if (s[i] == '-') { sign = -1.0; i++; }
    else if (s[i] == '+') i++;
    while (__rt_isdigit(s[i])) { v = v * 10.0 + (s[i] - '0'); i++; }
    if (s[i] == '.') {
        double scale = 0.1;
        i++;
        while (__rt_isdigit(s[i])) { v = v + (s[i] - '0') * scale; scale = scale / 10.0; i++; }
    }
    if (s[i] == 'e' || s[i] == 'E') {
        long e = __rt_strtol(s + i + 1, 0, 10);
        while (e > 0) { v = v * 10.0; e--; }
        while (e < 0) { v = v / 10.0; e++; }
    }
    return sign * v;
}

/* ---------------- numeric helpers ---------------- */

int __rt_abs(int x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x; }
long __rt_labs(long x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x; }
double __rt_fabs(double x) { return x < 0.0 ? -x : x; }
double __rt_sqrt(double x) { return __fsqrt(x); }

double __rt_floor(double x)
{
    long i = (long)x;
    double d = (double)i;
    if (d > x) return d - 1.0;
    return d;
}

double __rt_ceil(double x)
{
    long i = (long)x;
    double d = (double)i;
    if (d < x) return d + 1.0;
    return d;
}

double __rt_round(double x)
{
    if (x < 0.0) return -__rt_floor(-x + 0.5);
    return __rt_floor(x + 0.5);
}

double __rt_fmod(double a, double b)
{
    long q = (long)(a / b);
    return a - (double)q * b;
}

double __rt_exp(double x)
{
    long k = (long)(x / 0.6931471805599453);
    double r = x - (double)k * 0.6931471805599453;
    double term = 1.0;
    double sum = 1.0;
    int i = 1;
    while (i < 30) { term = term * r / (double)i; sum = sum + term; i++; }
    while (k > 0) { sum = sum * 2.0; k--; }
    while (k < 0) { sum = sum / 2.0; k++; }
    return sum;
}

double __rt_log(double x)
{
    if (x <= 0.0) return -1.0e300;
    long k = 0;
    while (x > 1.5) { x = x / 2.0; k++; }
    while (x < 0.75) { x = x * 2.0; k--; }
    double y = (x - 1.0) / (x + 1.0);
    double y2 = y * y;
    double term = y;
    double sum = 0.0;
    int i = 1;
    while (i < 60) { sum = sum + term / (double)i; term = term * y2; i = i + 2; }
    return 2.0 * sum + (double)k * 0.6931471805599453;
}

double __rt_log10(double x) { return __rt_log(x) / 2.302585092994046; }

double __rt_pow(double b, double e)
{
    long n = (long)e;
    if ((double)n == e) {
        double r = 1.0;
        long m = n < 0 ? -n : n;
        double base = b;
        while (m > 0) {
            if (m % 2 == 1) r = r * base;
            base = base * base;
            m = m / 2;
        }
        return n < 0 ? 1.0 / r : r;
    }
    return __rt_exp(e * __rt_log(b));
}

double __rt_sin(double x)
{
    double two_pi = 6.283185307179586;
    x = x - (double)((long)(x / two_pi)) * two_pi;
    if (x > 3.141592653589793) x = x - two_pi;
    if (x < -3.141592653589793) x = x + two_pi;
    double term = x;
    double sum = x;
    int i = 1;
    while (i < 25) { term = -term * x * x / (double)((2 * i) * (2 * i + 1)); sum = sum + term; i++; }
    return sum;
}

double __rt_cos(double x) { return __rt_sin(x + 1.5707963267948966); }
double __rt_tan(double x) { return __rt_sin(x) / __rt_cos(x); }

double __rt_atan(double x)
{
    int neg = 0;
    int inv = 0;
    if (x < 0.0) { neg = 1; x = -x; }
    if (x > 1.0) { inv = 1; x = 1.0 / x; }
    double r = x;
    int k = 0;
    while (k < 3) { r = r / (1.0 + __fsqrt(1.0 + r * r)); k++; }
    double x2 = r * r;
    double term = r;
    double sum = 0.0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < 30) { sum = sum + term / (double)(2 * i + 1); term = -term * x2; i++; }
    sum = sum * 8.0;
    if (inv) sum = 1.5707963267948966 - sum;
    return neg ? -sum : sum;
}

/* ---------------- process ---------------- */

long __rt_seed = 1;

int __rt_rand()
{
    __rt_seed = (__rt_seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648;
    return (int)(__rt_seed / 65536 % 32768);
}

void __rt_srand(int s) { __rt_seed = s; }
long __rt_clock() { return __ecall(30, 0, 0, 0); }
long __rt_time(long *t) { return __ecall(30, 0, 0, 0) / 1000; }
void __rt_exit(int c) { __ecall(93, c, 0, 0); }

void __rt_qsort(void *base, long n, long size, int (*cmp)(void *, void *))
{
    char *a = (char *)base;
    char *tmp = (char *)__rt_alloc(size);
    long i = 1;
    while (i < n) {
        long j = i;
        __rt_memcpy(tmp, a + i * size, size);
        while (j > 0 && cmp((void *)(a + (j - 1) * size), (void *)tmp) > 0) {
            __rt_memcpy(a + j * size, a + (j - 1) * size, size);
            j--;
        }
        __rt_memcpy(a + j * size, tmp, size);
        i++;
    }
}

/* ---------------- files and console input ---------------- */

struct RtFile { long fd; long eof; long unget; long mode; };

long __rt_stdin_unget = -2;
long __rt_stdin_eof = 0;

long __rt_fdof(void *f)
{
    long v = (long)f;
    if (v < 4) return v;
    return ((struct RtFile *)f)->fd;
}

int __rt_fgetc(void *f)
{
    long v = (long)f;
    long fd;
    char ch;
    long n;
    if (v < 4) {
        if (v != 0) return -1;
        if (__rt_stdin_unget != -2) {
            int c = (int)__rt_stdin_unget;
            __rt_stdin_unget = -2;
            return c;
        }
        fd = 0;
    } else {
        struct RtFile *o = (struct RtFile *)f;
        if (o->unget != -2) {
            int c = (int)o->unget;
            o->unget = -2;
            return c;
        }
        fd = o->fd;
    }
    n = __ecall(63, fd, (long)&ch, 1);
    if (n <= 0) {
        if (v >= 4) ((struct RtFile *)f)->eof = 1;
        else __rt_stdin_eof = 1;
        return -1;
    }
    return (int)((unsigned char)ch);
}

int __rt_ungetc(int c, void *f)
{
    long v = (long)f;
    if (c == -1) return -1;
    if (v < 4) { if (v == 0) __rt_stdin_unget = c; }
    else ((struct RtFile *)f)->unget = c;
    return c;
}

int __rt_feof(void *f)
{
    long v = (long)f;
    if (v < 4) return __rt_stdin_eof;
    return (int)((struct RtFile *)f)->eof;
}

int __rt_getchar() { return __rt_fgetc((void *)0); }

char *__rt_fgets(char *buf, int n, void *f)
{
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n - 1) {
        int c = __rt_fgetc(f);
        if (c == -1) {
            if (i == 0) return 0;
            break;
        }
        buf[i] = (char)c;
        i++;
        if (c == '\n') break;
    }
    buf[i] = 0;
    return buf;
}

char *__rt_gets(char *buf)
{
    int i = 0;
    while (1) {
        int c = __rt_fgetc((void *)0);
        if (c == -1) {
            if (i == 0) return 0;
            break;
        }
        if (c == '\n') break;
        buf[i] = (char)c;
        i++;
    }
    buf[i] = 0;
    return buf;
}

void *__rt_fopen(char *name, char *mode)
{
    long flags = 0;
    if (mode[0] == 'w') flags = 1;
    else if (mode[0] == 'a') flags = 9;
    long fd = __ecall(1024, (long)name, flags, 0);
    if (fd < 0) return (void *)0;
    struct RtFile *o = (struct RtFile *)__rt_alloc(32);
    o->fd = fd;
    o->eof = 0;
    o->unget = -2;
    o->mode = flags;
    return (void *)o;
}

int __rt_fclose(void *f)
{
    if ((long)f < 4) return 0;
    __ecall(57, ((struct RtFile *)f)->fd, 0, 0);
    return 0;
}

int __rt_fseek(void *f, long off, int whence)
{
    if ((long)f < 4) return -1;
    struct RtFile *o = (struct RtFile *)f;
    o->eof = 0;
    o->unget = -2;
    __ecall(62, o->fd, off, whence);
    return 0;
}

long __rt_ftell(void *f)
{
    if ((long)f < 4) return -1;
    struct RtFile *o = (struct RtFile *)f;
    long p = __ecall(62, o->fd, 0, 1);
    if (o->unget != -2) p = p - 1;
    return p;
}

void __rt_rewind(void *f) { __rt_fseek(f, 0, 0); }
int __rt_fflush(void *f) { return 0; }
int __rt_remove(char *name) { return 0; }
int __rt_rename(char *a, char *b)
{
    void *src = __rt_fopen(a, "r");
    void *dst;
    int c;
    if (src == 0) return -1;
    dst = __rt_fopen(b, "w");
    if (dst == 0) { __rt_fclose(src); return -1; }
    c = __rt_fgetc(src);
    while (c != -1) { __rt_fputc(c, dst); c = __rt_fgetc(src); }
    __rt_fclose(src);
    __rt_fclose(dst);
    return 0;
}

long __rt_fread(void *p, long size, long n, void *f)
{
    char *d = (char *)p;
    long total = size * n;
    long i = 0;
    while (i < total) {
        int c = __rt_fgetc(f);
        if (c == -1) break;
        d[i] = (char)c;
        i++;
    }
    return size > 0 ? i / size : 0;
}

/* ---------------- output sinks ---------------- */

struct Sink { long kind; long dst; long count; };

void __rt_put(struct Sink *s, int c)
{
    if (s->kind == 0) {
        __ecall(11, c, 0, 0);
    } else if (s->kind == 1) {
        char ch = (char)c;
        __ecall(64, s->dst, (long)&ch, 1);
    } else {
        char *p = (char *)s->dst;
        *p = (char)c;
        s->dst = s->dst + 1;
    }
    s->count = s->count + 1;
}

void __rt_sink_file(struct Sink *s, void *f)
{
    long fd = __rt_fdof(f);
    s->count = 0;
    if (fd <= 2) { s->kind = 0; s->dst = fd; }
    else { s->kind = 1; s->dst = fd; }
}

int __rt_putchar(int c)
{
    __ecall(11, c, 0, 0);
    return c;
}

int __rt_fputc(int c, void *f)
{
    struct Sink s;
    __rt_sink_file(&s, f);
    __rt_put(&s, c);
    return c;
}

int __rt_fputs(char *str, void *f)
{
    struct Sink s;
    __rt_sink_file(&s, f);
    long i = 0;
    while (str[i]) { __rt_put(&s, str[i]); i++; }
    return 0;
}

int __rt_puts(char *str)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (str[i]) { __ecall(11, str[i], 0, 0); i++; }
    __ecall(11, 10, 0, 0);
    return 0;
}

long __rt_fwrite(void *p, long size, long n, void *f)
{
    struct Sink s;
    __rt_sink_file(&s, f);
    char *d = (char *)p;
    long total = size * n;
    long i = 0;
    while (i < total) { __rt_put(&s, d[i]); i++; }
    return n;
}

void __rt_perror(char *msg)
{
    __rt_fputs(msg, (void *)2);
    __rt_fputs(": error\n", (void *)2);
}

/* ---------------- number formatting ---------------- */

void __rt_pad(struct Sink *s, int n, int c)
{
    while (n > 0) { __rt_put(s, c); n--; }
}

void __rt_field(struct Sink *s, char *prefix, char *body, int len, int width, int left, int zero)
{
    int plen = (int)__rt_strlen(prefix);
    int total = plen + len;
    int i;
    if (!left && !zero) __rt_pad(s, width - total, ' ');
    for (i = 0; i < plen; i++) __rt_put(s, prefix[i]);
    if (!left && zero) __rt_pad(s, width - total, '0');
    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) __rt_put(s, body[i]);
    if (left) __rt_pad(s, width - total, ' ');
}

int __rt_utoa(char *out, unsigned long v, int base, int upper)
{
    char tmp[72];
    int n = 0;
    int i;
    if (v == 0) { tmp[0] = '0'; n = 1; }
    while (v > 0) {
        int d = (int)(v % (unsigned long)base);
        if (d < 10) tmp[n] = (char)('0' + d);
        else tmp[n] = (char)((upper ? 'A' : 'a') + d - 10);
        n++;
        v = v / (unsigned long)base;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = tmp[n - 1 - i];
    out[n] = 0;
    return n;
}

int __rt_fixed(char *out, double x, int prec)
{
    double r = 0.5;
    int i;
    int len = 0;
    char tmp[40];
    int n = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < prec; i++) r = r / 10.0;
    x = x + r;
    long ip = (long)x;
    double fp = x - (double)ip;
    if (ip == 0) { tmp[0] = '0'; n = 1; }
    while (ip > 0) { tmp[n] = (char)('0' + ip % 10); n++; ip = ip / 10; }
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { out[len] = tmp[n - 1 - i]; len++; }
    if (prec > 0) {
        out[len] = '.';
        len++;
        for (i = 0; i < prec; i++) {
            fp = fp * 10.0;
            int d = (int)fp;
            if (d > 9) d = 9;
            out[len] = (char)('0' + d);
            len++;
            fp = fp - (double)d;
        }
    }
    out[len] = 0;
    return len;
}

int __rt_expo(char *out, double x, int prec, int upper)
{
    int e = 0;
    double m = x;
    int len;
    if (m != 0.0) {
        while (m >= 10.0) { m = m / 10.0; e++; }
        while (m < 1.0) { m = m * 10.0; e--; }
    }
    len = __rt_fixed(out, m, prec);
    if (out[0] == '1' && out[1] == '0') {
        m = m / 10.0;
        e++;
        len = __rt_fixed(out, m, prec);
    }
    out[len] = upper ? 'E' : 'e';
    len++;
    if (e < 0) { out[len] = '-'; e = -e; }
    else out[len] = '+';
    len++;
    if (e < 10) { out[len] = '0'; len++; }
    len = len + __rt_utoa(out + len, (unsigned long)e, 10, 0);
    return len;
}

int __rt_strip(char *out, int len)
{
    int i;
    int dot = 0;
    int epos = len;
    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (out[i] == '.') dot = 1;
        if (out[i] == 'e' || out[i] == 'E') { epos = i; break; }
    }
    if (!dot) return len;
    int end = epos;
    while (end > 0 && out[end - 1] == '0') end--;
    if (end > 0 && out[end - 1] == '.') end--;
    for (i = epos; i < len; i++) { out[end] = out[i]; end++; }
    out[end] = 0;
    return end;
}

int __rt_dtoa(char *out, double x, char spec, int prec, int alt)
{
    int upper = spec == 'E' || spec == 'G' || spec == 'F';
    if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'F') return __rt_fixed(out, x, prec < 0 ? 6 : prec);
    if (spec == 'e' || spec == 'E') return __rt_expo(out, x, prec < 0 ? 6 : prec, upper);
    int p = prec < 0 ? 6 : (prec == 0 ? 1 : prec);
    int len = __rt_expo(out, x, p - 1, upper);
    int i;
    int x10 = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (out[i] == 'e' || out[i] == 'E') {
            int sign = out[i + 1] == '-' ? -1 : 1;
            x10 = (int)__rt_strtol(out + i + 2, 0, 10) * sign;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (x10 < -4 || x10 >= p) {
        if (!alt) len = __rt_strip(out, len);
        return len;
    }
    len = __rt_fixed(out, x, p - 1 - x10);
    if (!alt) len = __rt_strip(out, len);
    return len;
}

/* Formats one conversion of a double with sign, padding and flags. */
void __rt_fmt_double(struct Sink *s, double d, char spec, int prec, int width, int left, int zero, int plus, int space, int alt)
{
    char buf[400];
    char *prefix = "";
    int len;
    if (d != d) {
        __rt_field(s, "", "nan", 3, width, left, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (d < 0.0 || (d == 0.0 && 1.0 / d < 0.0)) { prefix = "-"; d = -d; }
    else if (plus) prefix = "+";
    else if (space) prefix = " ";
    if (d > 1.0e300) {
        __rt_field(s, prefix, "inf", 3, width, left, 0);
        return;
    }
    len = __rt_dtoa(buf, d, spec, prec, alt);
    __rt_field(s, prefix, buf, len, width, left, zero);
}

/* ---------------- printf engine ---------------- */

/* Walks the format string; arguments are read from consecutive 8-byte slots. */
int __rt_format(struct Sink *s, char *fmt, char *ap)
{
    while (*fmt) {
        if (*fmt != '%') { __rt_put(s, *fmt); fmt++; continue; }
        fmt++;
        int left = 0;
        int zero = 0;
        int plus = 0;
        int space = 0;
        int alt = 0;
        int width = 0;
        int prec = -1;
        int lng = 0;
        int more = 1;
        while (more) {
            if (*fmt == '-') left = 1;
            else if (*fmt == '0') zero = 1;
            else if (*fmt == '+') plus = 1;
            else if (*fmt == ' ') space = 1;
            else if (*fmt == '#') alt = 1;
            else more = 0;
            if (more) fmt++;
        }
        if (*fmt == '*') {
            width = *(int *)ap;
            ap = ap + 8;
            fmt++;
            if (width < 0) { left = 1; width = -width; }
        } else {
            while (*fmt >= '0' && *fmt <= '9') { width = width * 10 + (*fmt - '0'); fmt++; }
        }
        if (*fmt == '.') {
            fmt++;
            prec = 0;
            if (*fmt == '*') { prec = *(int *)ap; ap = ap + 8; fmt++; }
            else {
                while (*fmt >= '0' && *fmt <= '9') { prec = prec * 10 + (*fmt - '0'); fmt++; }
            }
        }
        while (*fmt == 'l' || *fmt == 'h' || *fmt == 'z' || *fmt == 'j' || *fmt == 't' || *fmt == 'L') {
            if (*fmt == 'l' || *fmt == 'z' || *fmt == 'j' || *fmt == 't') lng = 1;
            fmt++;
        }
        char c = *fmt;
        if (c == 0) break;
        fmt++;
        if (c == '%') { __rt_put(s, '%'); continue; }
        if (c == 'd' || c == 'i') {
            long v;
            char buf[80];
            char *prefix = "";
            int len;
            if (lng) v = *(long *)ap; else v = (long)(*(int *)ap);
            ap = ap + 8;
            if (v < 0) { prefix = "-"; len = __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)(-v), 10, 0); }
            else { if (plus) prefix = "+"; else if (space) prefix = " "; len = __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)v, 10, 0); }
            if (prec >= 0 && len < prec) {
                char z[80];
                int k;
                for (k = 0; k < prec - len; k++) z[k] = '0';
                for (k = 0; k < len; k++) z[prec - len + k] = buf[k];
                z[prec] = 0;
                __rt_field(s, prefix, z, prec, width, left, 0);
            } else __rt_field(s, prefix, buf, len, width, left, zero && prec < 0);
        } else if (c == 'u' || c == 'x' || c == 'X' || c == 'o') {
            unsigned long v;
            char buf[80];
            char *prefix = "";
            int len;
            int base = 10;
            if (c == 'x' || c == 'X') base = 16;
            if (c == 'o') base = 8;
            if (lng) v = *(unsigned long *)ap; else v = (unsigned long)(*(unsigned int *)ap);
            ap = ap + 8;
            len = __rt_utoa(buf, v, base, c == 'X');
            if (alt && v != 0 && base == 16) prefix = c == 'X' ? "0X" : "0x";
            if (prec >= 0 && len < prec) {
                char z[80];
                int k;
                for (k = 0; k < prec - len; k++) z[k] = '0';
                for (k = 0; k < len; k++) z[prec - len + k] = buf[k];
                z[prec] = 0;
                __rt_field(s, prefix, z, prec, width, left, 0);
            } else __rt_field(s, prefix, buf, len, width, left, zero && prec < 0);
        } else if (c == 'c') {
            char b[2];
            b[0] = (char)(*(int *)ap);
            b[1] = 0;
            ap = ap + 8;
            __rt_field(s, "", b, 1, width, left, 0);
        } else if (c == 's') {
            char *p = *(char **)ap;
            long len;
            ap = ap + 8;
            if (p == 0) p = "(null)";
            len = __rt_strlen(p);
            if (prec >= 0 && len > prec) len = prec;
            __rt_field(s, "", p, (int)len, width, left, 0);
        } else if (c == 'p') {
            char buf[40];
            long v = *(long *)ap;
            ap = ap + 8;
            int len = __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)v, 16, 0);
            __rt_field(s, "0x", buf, len, width, left, 0);
        } else if (c == 'f' || c == 'F' || c == 'e' || c == 'E' || c == 'g' || c == 'G') {
            double d = *(double *)ap;
            ap = ap + 8;
            __rt_fmt_double(s, d, c, prec, width, left, zero, plus, space, alt);
        }
    }
    return (int)s->count;
}

int __rt_printf(char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Sink s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    s.kind = 0;
    s.dst = 1;
    s.count = 0;
    int n = __rt_format(&s, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return n;
}

int __rt_fprintf(void *f, char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Sink s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    __rt_sink_file(&s, f);
    int n = __rt_format(&s, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return n;
}

int __rt_sprintf(char *buf, char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Sink s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    s.kind = 2;
    s.dst = (long)buf;
    s.count = 0;
    int n = __rt_format(&s, fmt, ap);
    *(char *)s.dst = 0;
    va_end(ap);
    return n;
}

/* ---------------- scanf engine ---------------- */

struct Src { long kind; void *f; char *s; long pos; long pushed; };

int __rt_sgetc(struct Src *s)
{
    if (s->pushed != -2) {
        int c = (int)s->pushed;
        s->pushed = -2;
        return c;
    }
    if (s->kind == 0) return __rt_fgetc(s->f);
    int c = s->s[s->pos];
    if (c == 0) return -1;
    s->pos = s->pos + 1;
    return (int)((unsigned char)c);
}

void __rt_sunget(struct Src *s, int c)
{
    if (c != -1) s->pushed = c;
}

void __rt_sskip(struct Src *s)
{
    int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    while (c != -1 && __rt_isspace(c)) c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    __rt_sunget(s, c);
}

int __rt_scan_int(struct Src *s, int base, long *out, int width)
{
    long v = 0;
    long sign = 1;
    int got = 0;
    int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = __rt_sgetc(s); width--; }
    else if (c == '+') { c = __rt_sgetc(s); width--; }
    while (c != -1 && width != 0) {
        int d;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') d = c - '0';
        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') d = c - 'a' + 10;
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') d = c - 'A' + 10;
        else break;
        if (d >= base) break;
        v = v * base + d;
        got = 1;
        width--;
        c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    }
    __rt_sunget(s, c);
    *out = sign * v;
    return got;
}

int __rt_scan_double(struct Src *s, double *out)
{
    char buf[64];
    int n = 0;
    int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    int got = 0;
    if (c == '-' || c == '+') { buf[n] = (char)c; n++; c = __rt_sgetc(s); }
    while (c != -1 && n < 60 && (__rt_isdigit(c) || c == '.' || c == 'e' || c == 'E' ||
           ((c == '-' || c == '+') && (buf[n - 1] == 'e' || buf[n - 1] == 'E')))) {
        if (__rt_isdigit(c)) got = 1;
        buf[n] = (char)c;
        n++;
        c = __rt_sgetc(s);
    }
    __rt_sunget(s, c);
    buf[n] = 0;
    *out = __rt_atof(buf);
    return got;
}

/* Walks the scanf format; returns the number of assigned items or -1 at end of input. */
int __rt_scan(struct Src *s, char *fmt, char *ap)
{
    int count = 0;
    while (*fmt) {
        if (__rt_isspace(*fmt)) { __rt_sskip(s); fmt++; continue; }
        if (*fmt != '%') {
            int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
            if (c != *fmt) {
                __rt_sunget(s, c);
                if (c == -1 && count == 0) return -1;
                return count;
            }
            fmt++;
            continue;
        }
        fmt++;
        int suppress = 0;
        int width = -1;
        int lng = 0;
        if (*fmt == '*') { suppress = 1; fmt++; }
        if (*fmt >= '0' && *fmt <= '9') {
            width = 0;
            while (*fmt >= '0' && *fmt <= '9') { width = width * 10 + (*fmt - '0'); fmt++; }
        }
        while (*fmt == 'l' || *fmt == 'h' || *fmt == 'L' || *fmt == 'z') {
            if (*fmt == 'l' || *fmt == 'z') lng = 1;
            fmt++;
        }
        char spec = *fmt;
        if (spec == 0) break;
        fmt++;
        if (spec == '%') { __rt_sskip(s); int c = __rt_sgetc(s); if (c != '%') { __rt_sunget(s, c); return count; } continue; }
        if (spec != 'c') __rt_sskip(s);
        if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i' || spec == 'u' || spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'o') {
            long v;
            int base = 10;
            if (spec == 'x' || spec == 'X') base = 16;
            if (spec == 'o') base = 8;
            if (!__rt_scan_int(s, base, &v, width)) {
                int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
                if (c == -1 && count == 0) return -1;
                __rt_sunget(s, c);
                return count;
            }
            if (!suppress) {
                char *p = *(char **)ap;
                ap = ap + 8;
                if (lng) *(long *)p = v; else *(int *)p = (int)v;
                count++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'g' || spec == 'E' || spec == 'G') {
            double d;
            if (!__rt_scan_double(s, &d)) {
                int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
                if (c == -1 && count == 0) return -1;
                __rt_sunget(s, c);
                return count;
            }
            if (!suppress) {
                char *p = *(char **)ap;
                ap = ap + 8;
                if (lng) *(double *)p = d; else *(float *)p = (float)d;
                count++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 'c') {
            int c = __rt_sgetc(s);
            if (c == -1) return count == 0 ? -1 : count;
            if (!suppress) {
                char *p = *(char **)ap;
                ap = ap + 8;
                *p = (char)c;
                count++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 's') {
            char *p = 0;
            long n = 0;
            int c;
            if (!suppress) { p = *(char **)ap; ap = ap + 8; }
            c = __rt_sgetc(s);
            if (c == -1) return count == 0 ? -1 : count;
            while (c != -1 && !__rt_isspace(c) && width != 0) {
                if (p) p[n] = (char)c;
                n++;
                width--;
                c = __rt_sgetc(s);
            }
            __rt_sunget(s, c);
            if (p) { p[n] = 0; count++; }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int __rt_finish_src(struct Src *s, int r)
{
    if (s->kind == 0) {
        if (s->pushed != -2) __rt_ungetc((int)s->pushed, s->f);
    }
    return r;
}

int __rt_scanf(char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Src s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    s.kind = 0;
    s.f = (void *)0;
    s.pushed = -2;
    int r = __rt_scan(&s, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return __rt_finish_src(&s, r);
}

int __rt_fscanf(void *f, char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Src s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    s.kind = 0;
    s.f = f;
    s.pushed = -2;
    int r = __rt_scan(&s, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return __rt_finish_src(&s, r);
}

int __rt_sscanf(char *str, char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap;
    struct Src s;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    s.kind = 2;
    s.s = str;
    s.pos = 0;
    s.pushed = -2;
    int r = __rt_scan(&s, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return r;
}

/* ---------------- stream helpers (cout / cin) ---------------- */

void __rt___print_int(int v)
{
    char buf[24];
    struct Sink s;
    s.kind = 0; s.dst = 1; s.count = 0;
    if (v < 0) { __rt_put(&s, '-'); __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)(-(long)v), 10, 0); }
    else __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)v, 10, 0);
    long i = 0;
    while (buf[i]) { __rt_put(&s, buf[i]); i++; }
}

void __rt___print_long(long v)
{
    char buf[40];
    struct Sink s;
    s.kind = 0; s.dst = 1; s.count = 0;
    if (v < 0) { __rt_put(&s, '-'); __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)(-v), 10, 0); }
    else __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)v, 10, 0);
    long i = 0;
    while (buf[i]) { __rt_put(&s, buf[i]); i++; }
}

void __rt___print_char(char c) { __ecall(11, c, 0, 0); }

void __rt___print_str(char *p)
{
    long i = 0;
    while (p[i]) { __ecall(11, p[i], 0, 0); i++; }
}

void __rt___print_bool(int b) { __ecall(11, b ? '1' : '0', 0, 0); }

void __rt___print_ptr(void *p)
{
    char buf[40];
    long i = 0;
    __rt___print_str("0x");
    __rt_utoa(buf, (unsigned long)p, 16, 0);
    while (buf[i]) { __ecall(11, buf[i], 0, 0); i++; }
}

void __rt___print_double(double d)
{
    struct Sink s;
    s.kind = 0; s.dst = 1; s.count = 0;
    __rt_fmt_double(&s, d, 'g', -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
}

void __rt___print_endl() { __ecall(11, 10, 0, 0); }

void __rt___read_int(int *p)
{
    struct Src s;
    long v = 0;
    s.kind = 0; s.f = (void *)0; s.pushed = -2;
    __rt_sskip(&s);
    __rt_scan_int(&s, 10, &v, -1);
    *p = (int)v;
    __rt_finish_src(&s, 0);
}

void __rt___read_long(long *p)
{
    struct Src s;
    long v = 0;
    s.kind = 0; s.f = (void *)0; s.pushed = -2;
    __rt_sskip(&s);
    __rt_scan_int(&s, 10, &v, -1);
    *p = v;
    __rt_finish_src(&s, 0);
}

void __rt___read_char(char *p)
{
    struct Src s;
    s.kind = 0; s.f = (void *)0; s.pushed = -2;
    __rt_sskip(&s);
    int c = __rt_sgetc(&s);
    if (c != -1) *p = (char)c;
    __rt_finish_src(&s, 0);
}

void __rt___read_double(double *p)
{
    struct Src s;
    double d = 0.0;
    s.kind = 0; s.f = (void *)0; s.pushed = -2;
    __rt_sskip(&s);
    __rt_scan_double(&s, &d);
    *p = d;
    __rt_finish_src(&s, 0);
}

void __rt___read_str(char *p)
{
    struct Src s;
    long n = 0;
    s.kind = 0; s.f = (void *)0; s.pushed = -2;
    __rt_sskip(&s);
    int c = __rt_sgetc(&s);
    while (c != -1 && !__rt_isspace(c)) { p[n] = (char)c; n++; c = __rt_sgetc(&s); }
    __rt_sunget(&s, c);
    p[n] = 0;
    __rt_finish_src(&s, 0);
}
